We are approaching Eljune. You can see the Bloody Outpost in the distance, a place where epic battles took place. Let us honor the memory of the heroes who died fighting for it!

As for Eljune, this place is famous for its ancient history. It's where one of the main June cities, June Itsmal, was located. We uncovered its true secrets fairly recently, thanks to the talented researcher from the Empire – Marianna Lopatina.

According to the scholar Sarang Kharkhebi, Marianna's main accomplishment was not unveiling the obvious, but showing the mundane: the life of common peasants and laborers of that ancient epoch!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Look to your right. This is Tensess Temple. The greatest structure of the Zem people, it used to be one of Tep's Pyramids where this crazy Summoner spent thousands of years dying and then resurrecting.

We know that Tensess' Soul managed to banish Tep from the Pyramid, which created the Magic of Light. However, its true meaning was only revealed when Tensess' sacrifice was followed by Nezeb's and Skrakan's sacrifice. The League denied the obvious for a long time, but the unchallengeable truth of these facts forced them to acknowledge the authority of the Trinity Church!

@20.en:
On the right, you can see the abandoned Zem Ruins and archeological digs. A bit of history: the Zem civilization was situated in the Aether river valley. Originally, Zem tribes lived in small towns, and each had its own ruler, Negus or Nomarkh. Later these towns were united into the state of Hickut governed by Despots.

Before Tep's ascension, there was a rebellion in Hickut that put an end to the reign of Despots. A handful of their supporters fled the state. They are now known as Zem Heretics.

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Good afternoon, friends! Allow me to welcome you to the Holy Land. We are flying over the Coba Plateau. I'm certain you can appreciate the view. It looks so much like our homeland!

However, one must remember that nefarious arms dealers operated here. They collected Artifacts of Darkness.

This is where the tragic battle between Zem mechanics and Tep took place. Everyone died. Perhaps they will build a memorial here.

@20.en:
We are approaching the Coba Plateau. A scorched desert filled with ancient knowledge hidden deep underground... They say lots of miracles happened here. The chief one being the creation of the Holy Weapons... which then turned into the Artifacts of Darkness.

It was the mage Gorluxor and his demon cultists who desecrated the Holy Sites where the Power of the Light found its way into our world!

These days the place is scavenged by artifact hunters known as the Prospectors... They cleanse them and turn them back into the Sources of Light... But there are also people who use them for malicious purposes. The worst kind is the mysterious tavern owner. Some people see him, others don't.

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
It's quite a strange land full of ruins that remember the battles of the past... The problem is the scavengers... Goblins, the so-called Arms Mafia... As the League and the Empire started to lose their power, the Goblins' ambitions soared... They want to control everything that's against the law – piracy, smuggling, and all kinds of illicit trade. They got into Umoir while our ruler was busy with something else. They poach and sell animals. But we'll find a way to deal with them!

This is where our journey ends. Thank you for using our services.

@20.en:
We are leaving Eljune. The fortress in the distance is the Bloody Outpost. Many swords and shields were broken here. And the tents before the Outpost are the Eljune Bazaar, the Free Traders' camp.

You can say a lot about the Free Traders – that they only care about gold and will sell their mother for the right price. We must also mention the Tycoons – the seven wealthiest Traders. They are Ivan Chelezny, the ruler of Dane and its ports; Sigurd the Swindler, a meteorite ore miner; Hugh de Blizare, a newspaper and magazine owner; Profka the Fierce, the orc who is friendly with pirates; and a Zem whose name I don't know. They say he's the new owner of the Death Plant... There's also a Xadaganian among them – I hear she's involved in some unlawful dealings... and of course, the Master Goblin who has friends all over Sarnaut.

Dear friends! Look to your right, and you will see Tensess Temple. A mad Summoner called Tep was trapped in it, dying and resurrecting again for thousands of years! But Great Tensess banished him, and the place is now sacred.

They say Tensess left this world. And even his spirit is no longer in the Pyramid. But when he left, Tensess performed a new miracle – he predicted peace between the League and the Empire, and it has come to pass.

Of course, it will take years for the animosity to thaw, but this is where the first step took place!

Text.en: Hm... I thought that maybe someone from the village broke my ban and went to the old ruins in search for treasures, and found... the treasure, damn it! All kinds of nasty things dwell there. That's why we have sealed the portal with a special key.

It is hard to believe that, but once it used to be a thriving trade town. And here it was a tiny village, where peasants raised turnips and cabbages.

Now... it is all that's left. The town was cursed. The dead rose against the living!

The Inquisitors? Ha!

When things got pretty tough here, they sent a squad of clerics, led by thick-headed priest, who swung their incense burners and stank out the whole place with mirra. They took the key to the portal and went to the ruins. It was the last time we saw them. Now they must be roaming the town streets as well...
Greetings to you, dear guests! You came to our village at a dark hour...

I beg you, travelers - return!

I mean no harm to you.

In this swamp, you'll drown for sure,

like many did before.

The undead wander all around,

disturbed, they curse the Moon.

A Naiad has them all spellbound,

an evil spawn of doom.

The oaks are watching silently

the woods defiled by Mara.

They called her Ziva long ago,

the queen of forest wonders.

A blind desire ruined her

and struck the rest with madness.

When she committed horrid sin,

whole Iliy suffered badly.
Just a couple of words, whispered in our mistress's ear, were enough to drive her crazy with jealousy... They used to call her Ziva, but now Mara is her name!
You are right. Since our mistress went bonkers over that handsome guy, she stopped seeing anything around her. This made our life so easy!

Friends! Comrades! Warriors! Lend me your ears. I come to congratulate you on the greatest day of Sarnaut! The Anniversary day! We have come a long way, and the victories will live after us! Yet we have a longer way to go, and nothing withholds us from defeating the new enemy! Hurrah!

My dear and beloved brothers and sisters! With all my heart I would love to congratulate you on this blessed day of the Anniversary. I praise you and I thank you for all you have done, fighting for the righteous things. Unity within our ranks and unity with the Nature - this is the ground we are standing on!

I am sorry for not being used to pronounce speeches, but I will try to do one. It's the Anniversary, after all. Congratulations to the Kanians, the Elves, and of course, the Gibberlings. We are the family, and we are the League. Our unity is the most important thing we have!

The Anniversary is the day to remind us of the long way we have come, and of all the foes we have met. This day is meant to give us confidence, that we will go the way further on, and fight the enemy - again and again! The League has great powers. Nobody can keep our light from shining!

You do not really think you are able to do harm to someone who'd absorbed the ocean of pain, thus tempering the spirit, do you?
This is silly. My old body still bears the plague, and you've just let it out!
Oh finally! I have been waiting for this for so long! Power equal to that of the gods is now in my hands. I will not let go of it! Can you hear me? Never!
I'm sorry, but I'll have to leave you. Farewell, heroes! Great deeds await me.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Fool... We shall take what we came for... You cannot stop us...

@28.en: Bob: While you were gone... No, let me start from the beginning. So, there was a huge ship up in the sky. I thought it was going to crash straight into the tower, you know. I hated the idea of restoring it again! But they missed it by an inch! Collapsed and exploded on the shore.
Wienna: Allow me to introduce myself, Allod Keeper. My name is Wienna.

@20.en: Do you want some torture training? I can do that.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We don't give a damn about your settlers... Another newcomers from the Astral! Your allod is expanding! That's what interests us! Allods can't grow just like that! The growth began... just recently. It can be connected with these foroxites of yours, but... No idea. I don't know anything else.
Wonderful, Keeper. But I still think we should meet more often.

@20.en: Decrease the power of lightning!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It has the legacy of Light, it has the starting point of darkness. It equalizes everyone, regardless.

@20.en: The power of lightning proved too high, and an explosion occurred. You may start again.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Progenitor of worlds, the primal element. Once it is gone, the death is imminent.

@20.en: Do you think they care how much your training shield weighed?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Keeper, my name is Wienna, and I seek your audience.

@28.en: Bring it to me, Keeper. We must find out where the egg came from and why demons would need it.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Burn! Burn! This world will be cleansed and reborn in flames!

Text.en: Ah, we found another body. Not a single blood drop in it!

@28.en: All my life I've been dreaming of finding a match... Truly, it was well worth dying so many times!

Text.en: Well, this is a victory... Your victory... But let's see what you say when the consequences come! We will meet again!
I'm still so attached to you... Damn it! But there is a way to solve this moral dilemma...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hostile whirlwinds are blowing over us, dark forces are oppressing us!
Hostile whirlwinds are blowing over us, dark forces are oppressing us!
They told us to apprehend anyone suspicious. But everyone is suspicious here!
They told us to apprehend anyone suspicious. But everyone is suspicious here!
Unholy shadows are the product of temptation. May the Light protect us from temptations.
Unholy shadows are the product of temptation. May the Light protect us from temptations.
No matter how deep your bury your dark deeds, they will come to light sooner or later.
Messere has left this world, but we remain to continue his work!
We must lead the Elves to their true destiny! Sarnaut must follow the path of Beauty!
If Hirkalla restores our ancient kingdom, we can avoid mistakes and be like dragons!
What's in a name? That which we call a rose, by any other word would smell as sweet.
Honey is so sweet that it is finally bitter. Too much flavor kills the taste.
All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players They have their exits and their entrances, and one man in his time plays many parts.
Isn't this all funny? I think it's the most hilarious joke!
I miss Euryale a little... After all, you get used to someone over a thousand years of wanderings!
Sometimes grabbing a tiger by the tail seems like a good idea, but it’s not!
I don't regret choosing Messere! If I had stayed with Nemeina, I'd be dancing naked and covered in crow feathers!
Every day is like the last. How do I know I won't fade away tomorrow?
Every day is like the last. How do I know I won't fade away tomorrow?
We act on what we recognize as useful. At the present time, denial is the most useful thing - so we deny.
It started with your inability to put on socks and ended with your inability to live.
It started with your inability to put on socks and ended with your inability to live.
We should put the rich to work. They have hands after all.
We should put the rich to work. They have hands after all.
Some freaks from the other world. There's no one to talk or dance with.
Some freaks from the other world. There's no one to talk or dance with.
Hmm... turns out that existence without sex is quite possible. Imagination is the key!
Lol, we managed to beat these newbs again – their hands are growing out of their arses.
You know, sometimes I think that logic is just a way of deluding yourself lest you go mad with all the absurdity around us.
Skepticism is my best friend. It will never betray me, even when everyone else keeps believing in fairytales.
You know, I envy the optimists sometimes. It's so easy for them to live when reality appears as comedy.
Every time someone says "it's impossible", I just smile to myself. Most of the time, they didn't even try.
I always say that if you can't explain your idea with simple words, it may not be worth it at all.
Hey, don't you just walk by! Buy the magazines! I have the most recent new stuff! Games and music!
Ahh... all the trade will soon move to the Jeb-net! Where would we be going with our kiosks?

@20.en: Each moment is a chance to alter the world! We are not alone – we are many, and we are different!

@948.en: Alternative is the freedom of choice! Bright hair, bright life!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Tears are words coming from the heart, words that cannot be said aloud!
Dying was so sweet! But now, we have come to life again – and that's awful.
This world is the vale of suffering, but who can better realize it than the one who died and was then reborn?
If you have committed a crime, you will be coming with me, dead or alive.

@20.en: Every evening, I'm my own general! Hands off my couch and my games!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: All these cheni always throw themselves under the wheels!
The truth is out there, and I'm ready to look for it until my last breath.
Some mysteries are better left unrevealed, but I'm not one of those who would step back.
We live in a world full of lies, but truth always finds a way to burst to the surface.
Don't let anyone make you doubt the things you are witnessing with your own eyes.
You know, my family just happened to be among the embalmers – those who had to facilitate the peaceful rest of Hickut's lords.

@20.en: Due to the gifts from the Despots, we've managed to become rich, but it wasn't enough for some...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I think there was a shaft, and a fitting device for descending, somewhere around here.

@20.en: That's why there's so much of the brainless undead here... Charming, isn't it?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: When I was a little girl, I would often come down here to look at his grave...
When Tep and Ur dethroned the Despot, we helped with burying him securely, here in the catacombs...
One of us has turned to blood magic – the sinister art of Junes that they only taught to just a few...
There was a time when I wanted to be like her. But now, she dreams of getting back her power – getting back the Despots.
What could be more important than literature? Yesterday, we spent some of our salary and bought a few more papyruses.
We are the keepers of Hickut's wisdom! While the youngsters are playing games, we are collecting ancient scrolls!
I see the world as a place that needs to be endured, and my personal philosophy is "Kill or be killed".
I behave as though I don't care that people don't like me, but in fact, I am enjoying this.
Family is not just those who are with you, but also those who are with you forever – even if they are dead.
I'm not just weird, I'm unique. And that makes me deliriously happy.
Life is too short to be following the rules. Creating your own is much better.
Energize the entire Xadagan! Mana Energy is the future!
There's a leak somewhere along the line again... hundreds of miles worth of wires need to be checked.
You got to be strong, have the courage to say: "Hands off, get your damn hands away!"
You got to be strong, have the courage to say: "Hands off, get your damn hands away!"
When feelings cannot be expressed in words, music speaks for us.
Every chord is a step towards freedom, every beat is the pulse of life.
It matters not how long we live, it matters how we are using every single minute.
It appears that I shall soon have new ice sculptures to add to my collection!
I keep thinking of ways to beat that level. Gotta buy a hintbook with all the secrets...
I've been offered that new console – they say it's a perfect gaming system!
Where is the fringe between the living and the dead? We have been able to cross it!
The test subject body was twitching more actively yesterday than it did before... I think we should increase the current power!
Have you heard that the creation of robobeasts will be continued? They say the demand for augmentations is one the rise...

@20.en: Noooo! Someone help! Help... brothers... Skulnar... Stormrider... help!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We are nothing but toys in your hands!
Bit by bit, the power returned to me, and now I was finally able to use the simplest spells...
I grew stronger and stronger, the weakest of my abilities kept coming back to me...
At some point, I felt that I was able to use the necessary spells to defeat all the enemies here.
This was... an unexpected intervention. But I think we're both alright.

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Reniesta: I feel the information pass through me, but I cannot understand anything... What's going on, Klavdia?!
Klavdia: Everything is as it should be. This form of knowledge is not designed to be perceived by weak minds. But I understand everything perfectly.
Klavdia: This is what we were looking for. The world that Nihaz was trying to hide. The world he wants to conquer. The world...
Nihaz: ...of your mother. I shouldn't have expected you to be sentimental... There are other secrets in this Citadel...
Klavdia: I know what I'm looking for. I don't need your advice.
Nihaz: I don't doubt it. You are very fortunate that I'm busy with this invasion.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: He does look harmless... Fine, . Find out what he wants from us.
Well done...! Though I'm not sure Gort was very helpful in that fight.

@20.en: Reniesta, what would you say to a date after this fight?
That's better than beating up goblins in the Village!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Reniesta and I are two loyal comrades, we are like a strong wall!

@20.en: It's not my fault, it was the Elder's doing! He tricked me, too!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You needed to tell Reniesta the good news and continue onward...
You needed to discuss the events with Reniesta to make sure everything goes according to plan.
I have finally regained my strength... And I'm not in the habit of taking more than I need.
I sensed the energy of Sparks somewhere close... right underneath us...
Just a wave of the hand - and what I need is right in front of me...
All I had to do was hack Daddy's data storage.
We handled that easily, and I could finally focus on breaching it...
By then, the whole Citadel knew where we were... But that didn't matter anymore. There was one step left.
Our invasion didn't go unnoticed... But I wasn't trying to be discreet.
Soon I was distracted again - this time in a rather rude fashion, which made me really angry...
All I needed to do was tell Reniesta to remove the barrier...
The storage was where I expected it to find. I needed to open it....
We finally reached the place we needed, and I wanted to discuss the next steps with Reniesta...
Sparks were scattered around me - nameless, varied in size, ready to fill me with power...

@28.en: I hope you are not watching me from where you are... Because I’ve done terrible things.
Kyros, we are so disappointed. How could you? Didn’t we ask you to stay out of it? Didn’t we tell you that your pride will be the end of you?
Amos, you are the wisest of us. You were the one I came to and asked to use the power of creators against the enemies who were tearing our allod apart.
And I’d give anything to go back and die in her place there... but I can’t.
This is madness...! We are all grieving for Aellona. But trembling? Shaking?
You are not thinking clearly, Kyros. Aellona’s blood is on your hands, and I am forced to...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Before we were born, a terrible threat called the Architects came into this world. These creatures, united by their creator into a single mind, had only one purpose - to bring order to chaos, leading Sarnaut to Fractal, a world without fault.

@20.en: Residents of Sarnaut held off the servants of Order for a while, but everything has a limit. When it became clear that the First Architect, the core of the entire race’s mind, was coming to our world, they realized they needed cunning to defeat this enemy.
They decided to set Sarn against the Architect in hopes that they would take each other out. It was Sarnaut’s only chance to survive. And the plan worked.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Even though it was Sarn’s and Architect’s deaths that brought us to this world, we should remember that those two gods were not always corrupted by thoughts of destruction and madness. I am grateful for this, but I am also saddened by their tragic end.

@20.en: As I understand, you are born from this very Well? Aren’t you afraid that such interference may put an end to your entire race?

@988.en: Dear friends, the matter brooks no delay. Now that the nature of the Well is known to the world, someone will probably try and use its power to do harm. We cannot let this happen.

@20.en: Dear friends, the matter brooks no delay. Now that the nature of the Well is known to the world, someone will probably try and use its power to do harm. We cannot let this happen.

@988.en: That is why we cannot use its power alone, and no one should. If you take too much - you can easily cause another Cataclysm. Trust me on that... But we also cannot disregard the Well. This power can serve great purposes.
We chose the three of you of all the people of Sarnaut so you could help us find a solution - and protect the Well. In return, we will grant you access to its power.

@20.en: A interesting opinion. But what will the others say?

@988.en: My darling, it is not just a well in an obscure country village. It is the embodiment of power of two deities. A vortex of pure magic. In the entire Sarnaut, there is nothing more powerful than that. This astral will probably be gone long before the Well dries up.
As I understand, you are born from this very Well? Aren’t you afraid that such interference may put an end to your entire race?

@20.en: My darling, it is not just a well in an obscure country village. It is the embodiment of power of two deities. A vortex of pure magic. In the entire Sarnaut, there is nothing more powerful than that. This astral will probably be gone long before the Well dries up.

@988.en:
We cannot accomplish those goals alone. We would need hundreds of outstanding people to change this old world. If progress was easy to achieve, I would have long done that by myself...

We can use the power of the Well to form an Order. Or three, for that matter. We will unite heroes under one flag, one idea. And faith will bind them together.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The University I founded a century ago is becoming the University of Polis!
Knowledge is power, it's the light! Polis is worthy of keeping the knowledge. It will be the new scientific center! The cultural capital of our world.
Sarnaut's best minds are here to teach you everything they know.
Welcome, students! Remember, the pursuit of knowledge never ends, and it's never too late to start!
The Trinity of saints - Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan - gave their lives so that their descendants could live forever. Our fight is not over. We can’t die yet.

By the authority granted to me by the power of Light, I admit you into the fold of the Trinity Church. Let the Light strengthen your body and your Spark. Fight in the name of peace! Fight in the name of the Empire!

You will live for as long as you like. If your body dies, your spark will return to Sarnaut in another one. That is the order of things. Now go. Great deeds await you.

And remember: we’ll meet again...

@20.en: Tensess gave his life so that his descendants could live forever. Our fight is not over. We can’t die yet.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Go in peace, child... Let the Light guide you.
I admit you into the fold of the Church of Light. Let the Light strengthen your body and your Spark. Fight in the name of peace! Fight in the name of the League!
It’s your choice. We fought here side by side, and I don’t wish to spill your blood... But don’t try to stop me!
You! The Servant of the Light! You say your faith can bring people back to life... Bring Aellona back! You can do that!
You can't?! Well then you're a liar!! Who needs your false gift of immortality if the one who deserves to live the most dies?! You, you should have died instead of her!
Alas... Only the one who believes in the Light can resurrect. I cannot revive the dead; I just lead the Sparks of those who believed they were following the Light.

@20.en: Watch out! Demons dead ahead! Right helm! Head on the wormhole!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: In the Order of Balance, we’re all strong, and smart, and humble... So you should just go back where you came from. We’ll be the champions of Dionic Games!

@20.en: Good little bull... Let me offer you this humble... Aaah, point your horns some other way!
Pay attention to the Coliseum! It’s hard not to notice it - you can see it from any point of the Archipelago. It’s majestic, isn’t it?
These elegant statues and buildings were erected by Ionas and his students.
Right under your feet, there’s a huge labyrinth burrowed in the depths of the allod. You should see it!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I’m Khoor-Mahor from distant Howlem!
What raw force is good for? Our guys from the Order of Progress are also smart!

@20.en: Maybe I had a deal with another watch keeper. Maybe I didn’t have a deal at all... What does it matter? We have the batteries - let’s get out of here!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: He will be alright, don’t worry.
She is literally burning from the inside!
Asclepia, pull yourself together! If you can’t heal her, it’s not your fault but her fate...
You know nothing about fate. Step away and let me see her.
Ha... Now I see. Well... I will share her torment with her, her life and her death, and my fire will burn the Darkness in her heart. Pray to your gods that she survives!

@20.en: Take the First Place objective failed!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Bring three captives to the center simultaneously objective failed!
Don't use any checkpoints objective failed!

@20.en: You can do the rest yourself. Take Nobodie to the Labyrinth’s center. I will meet you there.
You need to wait until the Vigilant Minotaur walks away to sneak around his vision range.
Fly through rings while the timer runs objective failed!
Failed to earn 160 points!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Throw all balls into rings at the first attempt objective failed!
Now take my Pegasus and fly to the Observatory. I will set things up in the meantime.
Dear friends, we have prepared something very special for you. We are all looking for peace, but our life and our nature is one endless struggle.
And struggle can only be justified when it serves a greater cause and doesn’t push us to self-destruction.

@20.en: So this time we will struggle in the name of peace - at Dionic Games! But that will be tomorrow. And for now...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Dear friends! We welcome you in blessed Ammer! Thank you for accepting our invitation!
You do us a great honor with your presence.
But if any of you dares to spill the blood thy neighbor...

@20.en: Be sure that the punishment will be fast and severe!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Here, Dominae’s word is the law. And the law is: no war on Ammer!
Eat, drink, have fun - the night is yours!

@20.en: Let our music accompany your feast!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Remember: while you are on this land, there can be no war between you.

@20.en: We are one, and we are all brothers and sisters. Welcome, Sarnaut, to Dionic Games!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Dionic Games are a celebration of peace!
Now when there are so many peoples of Sarnaut gathered in front of me, I can see that this celebration will be even greater than we thought.

@20.en: I hope this day will mark the beginning of friendship between all the nations of our world!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Life is in everything around us - in each gust of wind, each breath, each motion, every thought.
You'll have to excuse me, I'm a simple gondolier, I sleep, work, and visit the brothel on occasion!
If you have any complaints about my work – refer to the residence of my House!
I'm very sorry, but I'm forbidden from indulging in idle chat at work!
Kuargh! Speak before the whole Irene hears of your treachery!
I haven't fought in a while, so you'd better hurry!
I'll pluck all your feathers out if you don't tell us everything!
This is a royal affair, and it means more than your life!
Tassilon, no one will hurt you. We have a common goal.
We'll do everything in our power to ensure your safety if you tell us the truth.
We are your friends. Those who ordered you to be quiet are our common enemies. Calm down.
Tassilon, this can still end well for you if you start talking.
Pull yourself together. We'll find what we're looking for anyway, but you can make our jobs easier.
You do important work, and they respect you on Irene. You can keep all that if you cooperate.
Don't you understand... I just can't tell you anything!

@20.en: I think what we're looking for is here, but I don't sense anything yet...
I can't make out anything... But I think we're in the right place!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We are leaving!
My intuition tells me we're close!
It looks like the general moved the camp to the foothills of the mountains in Silent Toroses, trying to escape Eurial. We should look for him there.
Go, and don't tell anyone about this. It's a state secret!

@20.en: You left Lucretia, she had to return to the palace!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You know, my marriage with Louis has always been political. It serves the interests of our House. We never loved each other...
Louis is too fond of politics, intrigue, the Great Game, and I prefer adventures... I wish I had the kind of freedom you have.
Or my son. He has already experienced more than I have! He sailed through the Astral seas on his Nautilus, and saw something no one else had seen!
It's hard to be a queen, the pressure of all that responsibility gets to me sometimes... I dream of real freedom and journeys...
I'm going alone from here. My meeting... will take some time. I ask you to wait for me and let no one inside under any circumstances!
The queen told me they'd be done in five minutes... But we must stay alert!
We can't stay here. Let's head back.
As you understand, we have to constantly deal with intrigues. Other Houses are actively looking for opportunities to cast aspersions on our king...
And the best way to do it is to discredit me. Even though Louis and I have an open relationship, and I ignore his favorites, we still need to keep up appearances in public situations.
If anyone finds out about my... ahem, relationship... and if they connect it to the Empire, it will be a scandal of unforgivable proportions!
What's worse is Cardinal Renard's new assistant! She is a viper waiting for an opportunity to strike while everyone falls for her innocent act!

A "lovely creature", a "living embodiment of the ideals of the elven race", a "goddess of beauty"... If only you knew how they praise this upstart! She's hiding something, some dark mystery of her origins, I'm sure of it!

It's done... Constance and I will return the way we came. Go to the king and tell him my request was fulfilled. Don't worry about us, the guards will keep us safe – we will probably get to the palace before you.
We're done. I was worried something like this would happen. But you handled it well.

@20.en: Show those wiseacres! Honesty and tolerance are crucial values!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we're beginning our lesson! Do yourself justice!

@20.en: How is your husband?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: What does it matter? Let's kick the stranger's sorry ass together!

@20.en: What a nice political subtext, don't you agree?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ah, why don't we find a pair of horses and ride off into the sunset?

@20.en: What a nice lawn, don't you agree?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Stop pretending! Everyone knows you are in love with a vampire!
What do you think of the brothel? I haven't been there myself, of course, but a friend of mine...
Would you like to dive in the deepest lake and find out what's down there?

@20.en: Come on, everyone!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Have you heard the rumors? They say your beauty is unparalleled!
...But on a serious note, I don't think the acceptance of vampires is a bad thing!
...But on a serious note, I prefer the elegance of elves! And not just the elegance!

@20.en: Oh, my love, my darling... I've hungered for your touch...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: When was the last time you wondered... Why are we here? Who are we? Where are we going? These questions haunt me on moonlit Irene nights.

@20.en: Look into my eyes, you will see what you mean to me...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Dear friends! This evening gave me food for thought...

@20.en: When I was young, I never needed anyone... And making love was just for fun...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Life can be difficult or easy, bitter or beautiful. So may yours be like a glass of wine!

@20.en: I hope you don’t mind that I put down in words... How wonderful life is while you’re in the world.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ladies and gentlemen! Join our lessons on social manners!
Don't miss out on this opportunity to demonstrate your social skills to high society!
Use this unique chance to join a social gathering!
Our lesson is in full swing – all we're missing is You!
Best compliments, small talk, and music – all of this, here and now!
We'll be happy to see everyone at our next lesson that begins soon!
We're doing our best to make each lesson more exciting than the last!
Soon we'll be back to help you improve your social skills!
Stay close so you don't miss your chance to enjoy good wine and music!
Our event is the best way not to fall asleep from boredom on Irene!
Next lesson is starting soon! Call your friends and enjoy yourselves!
Social gatherings are boring? Stay and prove it's not true!
Our lesson is starting soon, and we promise you'll enjoy yourselves!
Ladies and gentlemen! I would like to share something with you. Something personal...
Dear guests! I believe only a few of you know my name, but I have something to say.
Dear guests! Today I would like to share a few thoughts with you...

@20.en: How do you like it?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Attention, please! I don't want to distract you, but there's something I need to say.
When we all came to Irene, we were different. Cruel to ourselves and to others who were naive in their sincerity.
When I was a child, they once gave me a sword instead of a flower. It shaped my life, even though I didn't ask for that.
Sometimes we watch rabbits in a meadow and wish we were as happy and carefree as they are!
I enjoy listening to birds singing. Sometimes you can hear brilliant ideas in it, and here is what our feathered friends shared with me last time...
Like everyone here, I've read many excellent books, and I often come across brilliant ideas. Just yesterday I read this...
Here everything feels different. It's like my eyes finally opened all thanks to you, the wonderful people around me. Thank you for everything, friends!
There was something inside me, something that wanted to awaken. And then, in a brothe... ahem, on Irene, it finally happened. Thank you!
There are many wonderful things in the world, and the best are those around you. Love them, and if you can't – just don't hate them!
Everyone is capable of many things. So remember: no matter where you were born and who you are – everything is in your hands, claws, or wings.
Our path is a string of chances and patterns. Any mask or word can turn everything upside down. Appreciate what you have, and love each other!

@20.en: Decorum level increased! I wish I could pay everyone a compliment!
Decorum level increased! I want to say something nice to someone!
Decorum level increased! I want to say something nice to everyone!
Decorum level increased! I wish I could share it with others!
Decorum level increased! It's a beautiful night, it's perfect for speeches!
Decorum level increased! How can I stay quiet when I want to share my feelings with everyone?
Impropriety level increased! I wish I could slap someone...
Impropriety level increased! So many boors and snobs. I want to slap all of them!
Impropriety level increased! I want to grab a candelabrum and whack someone...
Impropriety level increased! There are many candelabra here...
Impropriety level increased! I'll show them how to make a real mess!
Impropriety level increased! I'm itching to dance, and the tables are right there!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Aren't you ashamed of your views on foreign policy?
Aren't you ashamed of your low social responsibility?
Hey, you! I'll bet my head that my pink bow is bigger than yours! How can anyone stand to look at you?!
Hey, you! I'll bet my head that my miniature poodle is bigger than yours! How can anyone stand to look at you?!

The stranger became King Grallon's guest of honor. Even though many were curious about him, he kept his secrets to himself.

Daguta felt more and more drawn to him, but it seemed like the stranger was oblivious to her feelings...

What's next? We'll see after the intermission!
Irene Kingdom was a beautiful place Even though it was surrounded by deadly Astral, the people felt safe...
Their safety was ensured not by the Great Mages or meteorite ore, but by a powerful artifact - the Key of Creation.
King Grallon always wore the key on his chest, and knowing this, everyone was at peace, because the king was true to his duty.
But the king had a daughter, princess Daguta, a lovely child of rare beauty. The king wanted the princess to find a husband.
But Daguta was capricious. She kept rejecting her suitors... Her father did not know what to do.  One day King Grallon summoned her and said...

"Well, this is a conspiracy!

Am I a king or not? Why do they oppose the monarchical authority?

Does my word mean nothing?"

"Fine, I'll allow it. He's not aware the princess has no patience.

And who knows, perhaps the uninvited guest will end up in the Astral.

"Well, our nameless guest. It's sounds strange to me, but I won't refuse my daughter.

So be it! You can stay as long as you want!"

"I can't deny my daughter anything!

Let the stranger stay as long as he wants.

Everything for Daguta, so long as she is happy!"

"It seems my word carries no weight!

What's a king supposed to do when no one listens to him?"

"I can't refuse my daughter!

I have indulged her every whim since she was but a babe. Everything she wanted was immediately handed to her!"

"Why are you standing there?

Or have you forgotten how a guest ought to be treated?

I'm hungry, and the road tired me out!"

"I see it's not the same now.

There used to be feasts that all of Sarnaut heard about!

Everyone knew this kingdom would greet you with sprightly songs and heady wine.

And no one ever doubted it."

"Excellent! Well, since I'm a guest here now, let us celebrate!

If our princess is unhappy, we shall make her smile!"

"I would love to remember the old feasts of Irene, when tables were laden with food!

And I could use some music, enjoy a song or two!"

"That time is past.

The time when humankind envied the elves' glory.

I would be grateful for anything you can spare."

"After the long travels, I would like

To feast and drink, and of course,

To have a talk with the princess!"

"That's right! I'd like to feast and dance myself!

Father wants us to suffer this bleak existence.

Will we live like this forever?"

"Eh, we can hardly expect a miracle!

My father is stingy when it comes to balls!

When my mother was alive, we had proper celebrations!"

"Let us celebrate!

Father, call for our troubadours,

Our dear guest deserves a proper feast!"

"Dear guest, I too long for merrymaking!

The kind of festivities where you meet all sorts of people!

What can be better than a grand ball?"

"There is no end to my suffering!

Will a miracle happen? Will there be balls, hunts, and feasts?

Or will I die from sorrow and anguish?"

"Really, why don't we have balls and feasts anymore?

Father's whims plunged us into despair!"

"How did you turn the kingdom into this?

Its greatness and power are nothing but ghosts of the past.

Well, we shall have to rectify this!"

"I see you are hungry for spectacles!

As strange as that sounds, I'll gladly help you!

Because I remember how it used to be."

"Your wish is my command, Princess!

I'll tell you what it was like when people were full of joy!

And then perhaps we'll discuss other things!"

"I'll be happy to fulfill the princess's wishes.

I will show you how to have fun, Daguta.

Let us invite your friends! Everyone you care about!"

"It's unfortunate that everything has been forgotten!

Well, I'll just have to remind you!

First, we'll have a feast, and then we'll see."

"Even though Irene is no longer what it was, I'll tell you everything, Princess.

About the time maidens wore colorful garments and troubadours sang of glorious feats."

"Damnation! So I have finally met the one

who is worthy of my hand."

"This is how you win someone's affections, Father!

This is a true hero worthy of my love!"

"He is wise and clever!

I enjoy listening to him speak!

It's time for celebrations!"

"Oh, sweet stranger! Your speech is so compelling!

It's like honey, sweet to the soul! Who, if not him?

Oh, powers of this world, I'm losing my head at the sound of his voice!"

"I think I'm going to die!

From sadness, because so much time was wasted before I met him!

It's too bad we only met now!"

"I wish you had arrived sooner!

Perhaps all my search for a husband was in vain?

Because here he is!"

"Well, will no one ask me?

Am I not the king?!

So be it, let them have fun!

I don't believe Daguta. She'll get bored with this one like with all the others!"

"You decided so quickly! Without me!

But personally I don't believe this will last!

She'll get bored with the dancing and this stranger!"

"It's all very strange, truly!

But if that's what Daguta wants, let the stranger stay for a bit!

Let us celebrate!"

"Daguta, darling!

If that's what you want, we'll have celebrations!

I'd rather not, but I will do it to make you happy!"

"It is a sad lot to be a father who is ignored by his own daughter!

Well, let them make merry, even though it pains me!

Let's see what comes of it!"

"They don't care about me!

Oh, well.

If my daughter is happy, then so am I!

Let them make merry."

"Daguta!

I'm angry with you!

Have you rejected your suitor again? You know the kingdom needs a ruler, don't you?"

"Oh, damnation.

 Another suitor was turned away. And only a distant cry reminds us of him.

 How long will this go on?"

"Daguta, my dear daughter!

Something disturbed my sleep last night!

It was a cry of the suitor who was thrown off a cliff.

When will this end?"

"Daguta, my precious child!

I want you to find happiness!

As long as you are alone, your life will be sullied by despondency!"

"Poor child! No mother, no sisters!

Are you doomed to be alone forever?

Or will there be someone worthy of your hand?"

"Woe is us!

Daguta's lot is not an easy one. She lost her mother, and Irene is like a prison to us!

How can I help you, child?"

"Are you going to scold me again?

I do what I like, that's how it is!"

"I did not wish to see him again after the last night!

He snored loudly and tired easily!

It's time to find someone else!"

"Father! I've grown bored with my lover.

I want to get another, but there's no one to choose from!

There are enough handsome men around here, but..."

"Oh, Father!

I can't find the right one - what do I do?

I've looked everywhere! If only someone as perfect as the one in my dreams showed up!"

"Am I doomed to look forever?

Will I never find my match? Woe is me!"

"Father! I'm in despair. No one around here interests me!

I want something different!"

"Daughter, this is outrageous!

Get me a rod, and pull up her skirts. It's time to teach her a lesson!

Ah, there's someone at the gates. This will have to wait!"

"If this goes on, we'll run out of subjects!

We already tossed the treasurer and the cook off the cliff. We don't have enough people left.

Right! Someone is here."

"It is funny, indeed. You've turned this into a challenge, Daughter! Soon we're going to run out of people!

You've tried almost everyone!

But wait, someone has just arrived!"

"Ah, my dear daughter, my poor child...

I don't know how to help you! I have invited everyone who is close to the court! All in vain!

What's this? Someone's coming!"

"Oh, woe is me!

It pains me that I can't help my daughter!

No amount of tears can help here!

Wait! I hear footsteps!"

"It is troubling, indeed!

What do we do? Where do we look?

Hmm, I can hear...

Someone is coming!"

"Despicable fools!

He has no right to give orders here!

Only a true heir can do this!"

"The king that rules the kingdom he has no right to rule!

And with him, the princess who is notorious for her promiscuity!"

"Here I am!

Who is this? A king? Indeed. And with him, the princess.

Well, let us start!"

"What's the problem? I don't get it...

Irene is beautiful, and so is the princess!

Nature was clearly generous, seeing how well-endowed she is!"

"Am I truly here? I don't believe it. It's been centuries!

And my Irene is as lovely as ever.

An exile's lot is a bitter one!"

"Irene is not faring well!

I remember the good old days. This is a shadow of its former glory!"

"My father is meddling again. A traveler has arrived, one we haven't seen before!

Will he let me speak with him?"

"He he. What a sight! He is so handsome!

Where is he from? I must find out! At once!"

"Oh, who is he?

Why is my heart beating so fast, like a bird trapped in a cage? What do I do? I don't know!"

"It can't be!

What is this? Why am I so fond of him?

If he doesn't stay, I'll throw myself off a cliff!"

"You interrupted us, sudden guest!

Well, we'll have to do it later. Tell us about yourself, but only the truth, because I shan't tolerate lies!"

"You are lucky, Princess! We've been interrupted but don't think I'll forget.

Now, the guest. I'm curious how you found us."

Who are you, traveler? What brings you here?

What do you want with my court? Are you here for Daguta's hand? Ha ha!

"Daguta, the light of my life, we'll continue our conversation later!

And you, sudden guest, listen to the king. Or rather, tell us: where are you from and how did you get here?"

"Cursed fate! Oh, strange guest. You have found yourself in a kingdom that has its glory days behind it.

We are surrounded by the Astral now, cut off from the rest of the world.

Tell us, how did you manage to get here?"

I welcome you, traveler!

What brings you to our kingdom? The world is fractured, and the paths that lead to us are not easy...

What brings you here? How did you get to our kingdom?"

"Oh! Trolls take you...!

If only I could tell you where I've been.

Would you recognize me?

But it's not time yet..."

"I have many names, and I've traveled many paths.

If I tell you about them all, even eternity won't be enough. I came here because of Daguta..."

"Oh, the irony! Your question is a curious one, and it saddens me that you cannot appreciate the humor in it.

But trust me, it is funny... I've heard of Daguta's beauty, that's what this is about!"

"Oh, this allod is so beautiful!

I've come from far away, and I'm going to leave it like that for now. I've heard a lot about Daguta's beauty!"

"I'm hearing mockery in this question. I've come home!

Even though the name that once inspired respect has long been forgotten.

But I wished to see Daguta, so that's why I'm here!"

"Well, the paths we far from easy, it's true.

I've been here and there, but there's nowhere I can call home. I'm an exile!

I came here to meet the one named Daguta..."

"Ah, my father! He's and old grumpy man who needs to know everything!

Let's not anger our guest, let him keep his secrets."

"Has your sight grown weak in your aging years?

Can't you see our guest is tired after his journey?

Leave your questions for later!"

"Oh, joy! How splendid?!

A traveler showed up, perhaps he'll stay awhile!

I only hope Father will stop grumbling."

"Oh, dear guest! If you wish to keep your name and occupation secret, then so be it.

We won't trouble you, so make yourself at home!"

"I'm crying at the thought I might be rejected!

All because of my father and his questions!"

"Oh no, is he going to leave us soon?

I must stop it! I'll find a way to keep him here!"

"What's going on here?

The princes is crying, the king is grim.

No, that won't do.

I want to see joy, not tears!"

"And while Grallon would very much like to know everything, Daguta won't stand for it.

It's so easy to put the right thought into that lovely head!"

"Princess! You needn't worry. It's not my intention to leave Irene soon.

I'm tired, and there are matters that require our attention!

Let us begin festivities!"

"I wouldn't dream of upsetting Daguta, so I can assure you I intend to stay for a while!

Irene will become my home for the time being!"

"The princess saves me from further questioning!

If it wasn't for her, I would've had to come up with something, because I couldn't tell them the truth!"

"Oh, how beautiful you are, Princess. I hate to see you unhappy!

But rest assured, I'll be here for a while!"
She quietly approached her father's bed and carefully took the Key of Creation off his neck.

With the Key in her hands, Daguta hurried back to her beloved to give it to him...

What will he do? We'll learn in the next act!
A lot has changed since a mysterious stranger came to Irene Allod. King Grallon's court has become a wonderful place...
Frequent balls, hunts, and feasts – life was a never-ending celebration, all thanks to the stranger whose name remains a mystery.
But Princess Daguta is getting more unhappy every day. She is falling deeply in love with the stranger, even though she does not know how to win his favor.
Her father is frustrated by her further descent into melancholy.
Needing to know the reason, King Grallon decides to ask the princess's new favorite...

"How dare you demand such a thing?

He is my father, and you want me to betray him?

But do I have a choice? If I give you the Key, this will bind us forever.

So be it!"

"What do you want? The Key? Or is it me you want?

If it's me, how can you ask this of me?

But if there's no other choice, I'll have to do it!"

"Ha ha! Right, what can be easier than stealing something he guards preciously?

But if that's what you want, I'm willing to do it!"

"Father's Key?

The artifact he guards like the apple of his eye?

Well, I'll do everything for you, my love!"

"If I give you Father's Key, I'll be cursed for eternity!

I'll be exiled!

But if that's what you want, so be it!"

You want me to betray my father by stealing the Key?

To tear my heart apart and choose between you and him?

But I've decided – I'll do everything for you!"

"I'm tired of fooling this girl!

I hope she brings the Key soon!"

"How easy!

All I had to do was ask, and the princess was willing to do anything!

Well, I'll be waiting."

"Daguta is lovely, but she is so easy to trick!

All that's left to do is wait for the Key."

"Oh, sweet Daguta!

It's not your fault I've managed to fool everyone around here!

I needed the Key, and now it shall be mine!"

"Can I trust her? It won't be easy to get the Key from Grallon!

What if she fails. What then?

Oh, fates, why must I place my faith in a foolish girl?"

"It saddens me that I have to trick this child, but there's no other way to get this Key!

I'll have to wait for her now!"

"Oh, my father! And my beloved!

They are tearing me apart, I can't please everyone.

I have to choose, even though I hate it.

Damn it all, I'll do what I must!"

"Father would probably hand the Key over himself!

But it would take too long to persuade him!

So I'll have to do it while he's asleep.

That way, we'll skip the unnecessary conversation."

"Honestly, the Key is just a trinket.

I'll take it, they'll sort it out later.

Yes, I'll just turn everything into a joke, then I won't get a scolding!"

"Father! Father!

What do I say? He won't just give me the Key. I'll have to take it quietly...

I just need to wait until he's asleep!"

"What now? Everyone wants something from poor Daguta.

I'm tired of having to decide!

It's not my fault that I'm forced to do this!"

"My heart feels heavy, because I have to betray my father!

To steal that Key and give it to my beloved!

It's awful, but so be it!

Where have you been, daughter? I've missed you.

What did you talk about?

I hope there'll be no more tears!"

"Daguta! There you are!

You seem quite content, Daughter.

How did it go? Did you enjoy yourself?"

"My daughter is back! How did your conversation go?

I hope your tears dried, and you are happy.

Let's get back to the festivities!"

"Oh, there's my daughter! You seem pleased.

I hope that conversation with the stranger helped."

"Can nothing make Daguta happy?

I see something troubles you again. What's ails my daughter?

I don't understand!"

"I want what's best for you!

I worry and I want you to find happiness.

Seeing you unhappy breaks my heart!"

"When will you stop torturing me with your questions, Father?

As for how it went... That's none of your business!

Go to bed!"

"Ah, Father! I've seen many springs, but you still don't realize

That I'm not a child, so you don't need to fuss over me.

Go to bed now."

"Oh, Father. I'm glad, truly. Soon I'll have everything I have ever wanted.

Aren't you tired?

Then go to sleep, I'm sure it will help!"

"Yes, I'm really glad! There's always hope.

I see you're tired, Father.

Maybe you should rest. Go get some sleep."

"Oh, woe is me! Woe is me!

What did I agree to?

I'll tell you, but later.

Let's talk about it in the morning."

"I'm sad and worried, Father.

But hopefully everything will be fine.

Don't worry. Tomorrow will be a new day!"

Oh, Daguta. I don't know what I'm going to do with you!

It's time for harsh measures!

I'll have you punished severely tomorrow.

But now I'm going to bed."

"Daguta is an odd child, no one knows what will make her happy.

We tried everything, but all in vain. Should I convene the Council?

I'll decide in the morning."

Push aside these heavy thoughts, Daughter. We're alive, so there's no reason to be upset.

Sleep will surely do me good.

I'm tired from all this business."

Oh, my dear daughter! You are right as always.

I do feel somewhat drowsy. Perhaps I should take a nap.

We'll discuss everything else tomorrow, because tomorrow is a new day."

"I'm crying with you, my daughter. What's the matter?

Oh, cruel fate!

I'm tired and stressed. I'll go lie down for a bit..."

I see nothing can make you happy.

Well, I'm tired of this all.

Hopefully sleep will help.

The sweet embrace of oblivion..."

"Oh, the Key my father guards!

I'm reaching out and taking it...

Let that treasure be cursed, since I'm forced to commit a crime!"

"What separates me from a crime?

The motion of the hand that reaches for the Key.

But no one has the power to stop me.

Even my conscience is silent now..."

"Ha ha! I'll take the Key!

Father is fast asleep, and nothing will disturb his dreams.

Luck is on my side!"

"Oh, Father is asleep. What does he see? My mother, perhaps?

The time when Irene was one with the land that surrounds the kingdom?

I'm taking the Key now..."

"Terror grips my heart when I think of what I'm willing to do to prove my feelings!

I'm holding the Key in my hand. It's done!"

"I feel so strange after betraying my father.

I'm taking the Key he's guarded for so long.

And it pains me that there's no other way!"

"The princess is unhappy again! I'm sick of this!

What else does she want, the flighty girl?

I've done everything I could!"

"Nothing pleases Daguta anymore, what else can I do?

Capricious child!

Nothing is good enough for her, she dreams of something that doesn't exist!"

"We've had feasts aplenty, everyone's joyous.

What else could you ask for?

I hope Daguta is happy as well."

"Daguta seems unhappy again!

Poor child! Nothing pleases her, nothing brings joy!

I don't know what I can do to change that."

"I've done everything I can for Daguta!

But it's all in vain, I failed to make her happy!

Damnation! When will she be happy?"

It seemed that things have changed.

Why is the princess still unhappy?

What's wrong?"

"I'm sick of these troubles of foolish girls.

But oh well! I'll have to help if the king wants me to."

"I'm not sure what I can do to please her.

Perhaps lashing will help. It usually does, they say.

I'll have to talk to her."

"Make the princess happy? How?

Tickle her?

Or dance in front of her?

I'll give it a thought."

"Dispel the princess's sadness? I'm ready.

I'll need to talk to her and find out what she wants.

Perhaps I'll think of something then."

"I have to satisfy some capricious princess's whims now!

As though what I've done already isn't enough.

Well, I have no choice."

"Soon I'll start crying over the princess's lot myself!

I have no idea what might amuse her.

I'll speak with her, and then perhaps..."

"The nerve of him!

I'm the king here, and yet my word means nothing?

Let him solve this problem, then."

"The stranger seems nice and polite,

And yet there's something suspicious about him!

We ought to keep an eye on that one!"

"This vagabond is so odd!

He's clever enough, perhaps he'll come up with something that would amuse my daughter!"

"I hope he'll be patient with Daguta.

She's as delicate as a lily!

We mustn't let anything distress her."

"When will Daguta be happy?

I fear I won't live to see the day!

I'll die before my time, having only known sorrow!"

"Who is he? It seems I won't know that.

Which is unfortunate, but at least my daughter will be pleased."

"I'm sick of these endless whims!

Tell me what I did wrong and what you really want!"

"I've met many young women, but none as capricious!

Tell me your secret - what do you do to make everyone so miserable?"

"Beautiful lady! Lovely Daguta!

I want to cheer you up!

Tell me, why are you sad?"

"Oh, where are you, Daguta?

A lovely child of elven blood,

It's time we had a little chat."

"It sounds like a simple task - to please a young elven girl!

But no, nothing in this world is simple!

It's easier to catch a dragon by the tail!"

"I'm looking for Daguta!

Tell me, what troubles your heart?

Why is your world so bleak? Tell me."

"How rude! He's mocking me!

I've longed for your touch for days, but you rejected me!"

"He shows up like nothing's wrong!

It's the second night I approach the bedrooms and he immediately disappears!

"I'll happily laugh if you are with me, dear friend!

Tell me, how can I prove you are more important to me than the whole Irene and my father?"

"Sweet stranger!

I don't know what else would please you! What do you want from me?

How do I prove the sincerity of my feelings?"

"Everything around makes me unhappy!

I'm rejected by my beloved.

He doesn't care for me - he shuns my embrace, pushing me away!"

"I've missed you terribly!

But you are cold as ice! I can't figure you out!

Tell me, how can I be with you?"

"I sense treachery in you.

You've chosen people before, but once you grew bored with them, you discarded them.

How foul!

I wouldn't want to be one of them!"

"Words alone are of little worth.

Today you sing like a nightingale, but that's just a passing fancy.

I wish I could trust you, but how?"

"But darling, you've done nothing to prove I'm dear to you.

And in these matters, you can't trust words alone."

"Something weighs heavily on my heart.

Is this a jest?

What if everything turns out to be a game?

How can I trust you?"

"Yes, it saddens me as well.

You speak of love, but is there any truth to it? I can't see it.

I need more than words. I need actions!"

"Truly, what do you want me to do?

Jump off a high tower to prove some point?

What actions do you need?"

"Proof, you say. But what should I do?

If you demand it, and you don't believe me,

Then I shall do what you want me to do!"

"So I need to prove something I've longed for?

But I'm no knight, I don't perform feats in honor of some fair maiden.

How do you intend to test me?"

"What proof do you need?

How can I earn your trust?

I'm not sure what I can do here."

"No one here trusts me - not you and not even my father!

Well, that's my lot!

I'll have to do whatever you ask of me!

"It seems my lot is one of tears.

For I don't know how to prove it to you!

What should I do? I don't understand."

"I'm angry! My foolish daughter is willing to believe anything.

And this stranger? Can I trust him?

Who knows what he's plotting?

"It is a peculiar situation: my daughter with her empty head.
And the stranger that no one knows anything about.

And yet, we put our trust in him.

The hand of fate is fickle."

"It's strange. Perhaps it's wrong to allow

Some stranger to converse with Daguta.

I'd laugh at the joke myself.

The king's empty word!"

"What are they talking about for so long?

I hope he succeeds where I did not.

Daguta, Daughter, just don't bring trouble on us!"

"My heart is heavy.

Perhaps I was wrong to trust a stranger?

He has Daguta wrapped around his little finger, along with everyone else!

What do we do?"

"I'm worried about this.

My daughter and this stranger!

What does he really want? Why is he here?

I fear he may bring trouble on us."

"I'm angry: I want to get back one thing.

The king, your father, has the Key of Creation. Bring it to me!

This is how you can prove you're on my side!"

"Oh, proof of love! Well, that's easy.

Your father wears a powerful artifact around his neck.

Bring it to me, and that will prove everything."

"Daguta, you precious flower!

I'd hate to force you. But...

Grallon's artifact, the Key. I want it.

If you get it for me, dove, then I'll believe everything you say!"

"There's something I want more than anything else. It's the Key.

The artifact Grallon wears on his chest.

I beg you, please help me! Take it and bring it to me.

And we will be together."

"There's only one thing I need:

I'm talking about the Key.

The one King Grallon has.

Bring it to me!"
No one has seen Irene Allod ever since. When it disappeared, it became a legend of a lost kingdom.
Only a few people managed to escape through a portal, and none of them knew where the stranger with the Key of Creation disappeared to.
As for Daguta... A silent shadow was all that remained of the princess and everyone who died among the Astral waves because of her!
Balls and feasts do little to lift Princess Daguta's spirits. For the first time in her life, the reason for her melancholy is unrequited love!
The guest she adores is giving her a cold shoulder and refuses to believe her feelings are true, because Daguta has rejected all her previous lovers.
Taking advantage of the enamored princess's weakness, the mysterious guest sweet-talks her into getting an artifact from King Grallon.
Hoping to prove her love, the girl sneaks into the king's chambers while he sleeps and takes the Key of Creation off his neck.
At dawn, Princess Daguta hurries to her beloved with the Key in her hands...

"Daguta! You are foolish, indeed!

How could you give my Key away?

It was the only thing keeping us safe from the encroaching Astral!

We are doomed now!"

"Funny, indeed!

The deadly Astral is upon us, the walls are crumbling to dust.

Is this the end?"

"There's nothing funny about this!

But I'll be optimistic and say that, impending doom notwithstanding,

This story will be a lesson for all of us."

"Oh, what a troublesome child!

Come on, Daguta! Over here, Daughter.

The Astral is swallowing everything!"

"Daguta, where are you?

I hear everything that's happening: the merciless Astral is crushing our walls,

And everything is dying!"

"Oh, Daguta!

How could you let him trick you so easily?

How gullible are you that you didn't realize what he intended?

We're in big trouble!"

"I was once condemned to exile here.

Irene is vast, but the name of Elleken is almost forgotten!

I reminded everyone and had my revenge.

But now the road calls!"

"The people here used to know the founder of the Conclave, the first of the Great Mages...

He is standing before you, Irene!

I'm looking at you one last time, and then I'll keep moving."

"I'm fond of this wondrous city. Farewell!

You will disappear and be forgotten forever.

And I, your first Mage named Elleken, will give you my last bow."

"The last moment of the tragedy!

Soon this beautiful city will be lost to the abyss!

Farewell, Irene! It is not without remorse that Elleken parts with you!"

"I'm forced to leave my home again...

No one remembers Elleken, but he remembers everything!

Irene will be forgotten, but not by me.

I'll keep it in my memory..."

"Oh, sadness grips my heart!

My Irene, an elven allod, a shard of the kingdom where I became the first Mage!

Remember the name Elleken who bids you farewell."

"Daguta, what have you done!

Everything is falling apart now, save yourself!

Come, foolish girl!

There's no other way!"

"Daguta! If you want to live, hurry!

Over here, Daughter. Come here!

There's doom, darkness and crying everywhere. It's your fault!"

"In this dreadful hour, we remember our past: our feasts and balls!

If Daguta hurries up, perhaps I can save her!"

"Over here, Daguta!

I'll save you if you find me.

A storm is raging through the place, born from the Astral."

"The hopes are dwindling. Everything is swallowed by nightmare!

If you want to live, Daguta, you will find me!

We have a tiny chance of survival!

"What do I do? Daguta, where are you?

Daughter, come here! I want to save you!

It will crush me if you don't make it!"

"Curse that traveler and the day he showed up at our gates!

I loathe him with all my heart!

Now I'm doomed!"

"I was tricked, Father, so I doomed myself!

My name will become a byword for gullibility!

This is how my story ends!"

"It's ironic, Father! But I deserve this!

I believed false promises and doomed myself!"

"I'm sorry, Father! I won't escape with you!

Save yourself, I'm already dead.

Farewell, cruel world!"

"Oh, tears of woe. I can't escape now! Daguta is done for!

I can't reach her, there's destruction everywhere!

Farewell, Irene. And you, Father!

"Father, Father!

There’s no escape!

The Astral is everywhere, I can't reach you!

Farewell, Father!"

"May the one who caused this suffer divine wrath!

I won't forget you, accursed traveler!"

"Daguta believed the flatterer and brought doom upon us!

Let it be a lesson for everyone who trusts strangers!"

"I will laugh to keep myself from crying.

I lost everything - my daughter and my city!

Let this story become a legend!"

"Daguta is no more. The waves of the Astral closed over her. My daughter is dead, and so is Irene!

Everything I have ever loved is gone!"

"There is no end to this sorrow!

Daguta, the light of my life, is dead!

And Irene is gone forever."

"I'm crying, mourning what I've lost!

My dear daughter, and the kingdom that existed long before me!

Everything disappeared in the blink of an eye, as though it had never existed..."

"Irene is gone! Who is to blame?

Perhaps the people who exiled me and started the tangle of fate that leads here?"

"Every story can be a lesson for us.

While it was a dreadful hour when the Astral swallowed the city, many songs have been written about it!

They were quite popular at feasts."

"This is how the story ends!

Few escaped, but that's when the legend was born!

Bards sang of it, and everyone who heard it was delighted!"

"The story ends there.

Irene was lost, and no one knew what became of it.

Only bards sang of its former glory."

"Let us mourn Irene and the kingdom that disappeared so abruptly!

Many have dreamt about visiting it,

But merciless Astral reigns there today!"

"I couldn't tell you a sadder story!

Elven Irene was lost, and only a handful survived!"

"Damnation! I should be suffering pangs of conscience!

But I don't feel guilty at all.

I wanted to prove my love, and I will!

"As for the Key, it's already mine,

I'm my father's heiress, after all, so I would have inherited it eventually.

Now I can prove everything."

"Ha ha! I managed it when Father fell asleep. I took the Key!

My beloved will finally believe my intentions are genuine!"

"I didn't let my beloved down!

I did what he asked. I have the Key.

Was I wrong to do it?"

"What do I do? I feel troubled.

But I believe I did the right thing...

But it's too late to dwell on that now...

What's done is done..."

"I failed my father...

He has guarded this thing, and now I'm taking it to my beloved.

Let it be a good proof!"

"Where is she? Oh, foolish princess!

I tricked you, and now it's my turn to suffer!

I'm forced to wait for you to succeed!"

"It was easy to fool the princess.

She might not be smart, but I still did my best.

And soon I'll harvest the fruit of my labors if I get my hands on the Key."

"It's easy to handle things on Irene... I've managed to fool everyone.

And now I'm waiting for the princess with the Key, ready to celebrate my triumph!"

"Lovely Daguta! Where is she? Did she do it?

I've dreamt of this.

I'm so close to my goal."

"I'm only a step away from victory, but the wait is frustrating!

Can the princess do it or will she fail? I can't tell."

"I'm overcome with sadness!

What happens if the princess fails to accomplish the task?

I'll have to abandon my plan..."

"There's no rest even at night, my daughter's ghost is haunting me!

Daguta, there's no escaping you.

Perhaps I should lock my daughter up in the tower!"

"I don't remember what I dreamt of.. But I think I saw Daguta!

She was standing over me. I don't know what she wanted!

The things you see in dreams..."

"I'm awake, it's morning. The day is bright and full of beauty.

I feel like I saw my daughter here last night. Or was it just a dream?"

"I had a strange dream. As though Daguta was here...

But I don't remember what she wanted.

Where did she go?"

"The dawn is chasing all dreams away.

Cruel world! There's so little left of the past.

What did I dream of? I don’t remember.

Only Daguta... I saw her last night..."

"The dream is gone, but something remains, as always. Some kind of vision!

I don’t remember much, but I think I saw Daguta...

Ah, damn..."

"Oh, my friend!

You asked for proof that we didn't really need, and I procured it.

Here is the Key you wanted so much!"

"I did the unthinkable!

No one has ever asked for the kind of proof I've gotten for you.

I stole the Key my father held dear."

"Oh, where is my beloved?! I've done what you asked!

I have Father's artifact, the Key of Creation.

I'll give it to you now!"

"Oh, sweet stranger! Are you there?

I've brought the Key. I'll give it to you."

"Darling!

I have what you asked for – I'll give it to you now!

My fate is sealed now.

What I've done will always haunt me!"

"I'm giving you the Key with a heavy heart.

But where is my beloved? Are you there?

I have sacrificed so much for you!"

"How did you hide something you took from me?

You didn't know where the Key had come from...

Now it's mine, as it should be!"

"Indeed, now I have what I've wanted!

My path wasn't easy, but I've accomplished what I set out to do.

And now, with the Key, I can do so much more!"

"Splendid! I have finally recovered what I once lost.

So now I'm going to put it to good use."

"Daguta, sweetheart!

You have it... Wonderful!

You've done what I asked and brought me the Key I once lost..."

"Oh no, oh no! It can't be! Is it really it?

The Key I once lost?

I can't believe I'm actually seeing it..."

"It can't be! I don't believe my eyes!

Something I once lost has returned to me!

I've been through so much to get to this point."

"But what am I hearing? You are talking about the Key?

What about me?

The one who incurred the king's anger by getting it for you?"

"The Key, the Key... I want something, too.

Let's make love until sunset, maybe longer!"

"If you're happy, then so am I. Let's celebrate!

Love is so sweet, and we'll both be drunk with it!"

"Oh, sweet stranger, I've given you what you wanted.

Do you believe now that I love you?"

"Cruel fate!

I got the Key for you, and where is the gratitude?

I've done what you asked, I've committed a crime!"

"You speak as though this Key means more to you than I do!

It hurts to hear that!"

"You are a fool, princess.

I didn't need you, I've gotten everything I wanted.

It's time we part ways. Farewell!"

"Ha ha! I deceived you, princess.

I got what I wanted.

This is where we part ways.

I'm sorry, truly, but I must go now!"

"Ah, we'll never be together, Daguta.

I'm grateful for the Key, but that's all I ever wanted.

I'm leaving you here.

It's sad, but such is life!"

"With sorrow in my heart, I must tell you

That we must go our separate ways!

I've gotten what I wanted, so I'm leaving this allod!"

"Daguta, you insolent child! What have you done?

Where's my Key? Where is it?

We are doomed without it!"

"Daguta, is it true that you stole my Key?

This angers me.

As though you don't know what the Key is!"

"Daguta, Daughter! What is this, a jest?!

Where is the Key that protects the allod?

There'll be no laughing anymore if it's lost!"

"Daguta, sweetheart. What's going on? Where is my Key?

If it's missing, terrible tragedies will befall us!"

"Oh, Daguta! This is terrible!

The Key that protects us against the Astral has been stolen! We are doomed now!

Did you have anything to do with it?"

"Oh, Daguta. What have you done?

Where's my Key that protects Irene from the deadly Astral?

I need to make haste!"

"Accursed stranger! Father, can you hear that?

He tricked me, the scoundrel! He lied. He never wanted me...

Once he got the Key, he left."

"Father, the stranger you fed and entertained has left us!

He deceived me... It was your fault!

And the Key is lost now..."

"Ah, Father...

You will laugh but it looks like you were right to be concerned...

The stranger has left us. With the Key..."

"Was I deceived?

How did it happen? What do we do now?

Father, save us! I believe I made a mistake by trusting him...

And the Key is missing now..."

"Oh, Father. It's all gone! He has the Key, and he left...

He tricked me into getting this Key you were guarding!

What do we do now?"

"Father, Father!

I think I was deceived.

The stranger took your Key and disappeared.

I don’t know what to do..."

Dear friends!

Perhaps you were waiting for an unusual symphony from my House...

Mainly thanks to the performers who arrived from various corners of Sarnaut.

Tell me, are there many nuances in a tune with just 3 notes?

No!
The song of our world will sound right only when each of its nations plays their part!

We are different, but we are capable of singing in unison.

Together, we can do so much more!

...no, Baudouin, we're not going to change its shape. Let stonecutters like Pluie do it.

That one's out of the way. Now to the harder task: two targets, one shot.
These statues could make excellent battering rams. Have you given it a thought?
It was easy. Now the last and hardest part. Be patient, .
Well, it's up to you, . We've seen what we needed to see. We can go back now.
We'll either win or leave a lasting impression. Either way, it'll be good.

[Skulnar the Fierce]: Well-well... this one has seen your Iris with an Alliance soldier... but the girl didn't want her to tell anyone. Well, technically, she hasn't. Not a word!
[Skulnar the Fierce]: That's what I call a decent man, even though he's an elf. He has my respect. Let's search your friend's house. We might find something else.
[Skulnar the Fierce]: She's lying. The last time your Iris was seen with her sisters Gala, Claire, and Ivetta. Perhaps, some them are more talkative.
Here I am! Did you think I can't recognize you without pants? No way.
How do you like my outfit? The big-eared girl at the entrance told me I was unbelievable.
Remember how Iris's diary mentioned Sweet Candy? I get it now! We don't need magic to find her.
Hey! Why are you following me? Get out of my sight.
No. As agreed, I delivered to your men. And then I looped around the city to cover my trail.
Hey! Do you think the elves... Well... You know?
Always do sober what you said you'd do drunk.

I used to jog, but the ice cubes kept falling out of my glass.
I'm an old sick Priden, I have a weak heart, I'm not allowed to worry.
Maybe we should run a brothel here...
I'm going to make you an offer you can't refuse! How do you like it?
I'll be partying tonight. Happily and with harmless pranks. What do you think?

@20.en: Great Forces! There was nothing here to make you this drunk! How did you manage that?

Don't mix sparkling wine with anything, it will rush to your head! Maybe you should get some fresh air?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: At least someone here knows how to have a good time! Everything is so prim and proper here.
It was a good decision to invite other races here! They are so funny, just look at them!
Ahaha! The Hero of Sarnaut is blind drunk! I'll tell everyone about this!

@20.en: My cousin and his girls are late, it would've been even funnier! All that's left is too drink...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I don't even know what to say... How to comment on this.
