! You shouldn't drink so much, for the Ball is not over yet. Who knows what might happen?
Let's give people something to talk about! We'll pester them with indecent questions!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Let's do it! But  should start!
Hey! Enough! What are you doing? This is not the place for that!
So we came here all together, destroyed the painting, ate everything, then went down to get more food...
Let's ask the king, he probably knows everything that happened in the ballroom!
I wonder what he painted. We'll ask him when we find him.
Smells like old rags and powder. Must be some actor's scent.
Smells like leather, steel, and poison... And an old, dark pond... and lilies. That's Eurial.
I can't smell anything else... These rats drown out all other scents!
We can breathe again! Let's see what's near the obstruction...
The smell is coming from behind the obstruction. We'll have to clear it! Go find help, I'll stand guard.
The trail leads to the... burrow? That's suspicious! Why would Skulnar go into a burrow?
Good job, ! I should've made you the guard captain!
You must keep moving, . According to her, we don't have much time. We'll take care of her, and then we'll send help.
, try not to die. Eurial is quite dangerous. And don't kill her either - I have many questions for her.
It's interesting to watch your fight. At the Palace, we seldom get the opportunity.
I believe I'm starting to understand what's going on. It's not a coincidence that Elleken's name was first mentioned here, during the performance. Until today, no one knew who had stolen the Key...
Come here, let's talk. The others should stay where they are and continue to pretend they have any word in this.
Onward, Tamino! Our master's enemies must not disrupt his plans!
I need the Key of Darkness! With its help, I can bring eternal night to Sarnaut!
My mother is obsessed with revenge. It's rather disturbing...
The reign of the House de Velund was a glorious time in the elven history!
The night steers its corvette among the stellar spheres. A crescent moon instead of the heart, and the shine of comets instead of tears.
Master has always been kind to Sparafucile... He will pay me for your head!
I've killed hundreds of thousands like you over the years of my life!
I've killed kings and prelates! I've killed Great Mages and peasants!
Of course, dragons are far superior in the art of killing... I have ways to go.
Hmm... I should've expected something like this. I'll try and find out if Zayan can do something about it...
Look, it seems they are letting you pass. Don't keep them waiting, Hero of Sarnaut.
Go, Pamina! In the name of our master, we will complete the Great Plan!
Fools! Don't you understand that everything preordained must come to pass?
I don't like snakes, but Eurial is rather lovely... Don't you agree, Pamina?
There is no struggle between light and darkness. They complement each other, just as night follows day...
There has been no real sun in this world for a thousand years! I dream of seeing it with my own eyes!
Are you trying to stop Elleken? Can't you see how laughable this is?
How can you be so naive? You're lost in a labyrinth, and only Master knows how to escape it!
There were many of them, Nihaz's chosen, but few were worthy.
Where's that killer? He's never around when we need him!
There's nothing funnier than elves who have forgotten their ideals! They worship Pleasure instead of Beauty!
A bunch of Houses who believe they are Great! What do they know about true Greatness?
Elves used to bring changes to the world, but now the world has changed them instead! Isn't that what their tragedy is about?
Well, when I started my experiment on Grok back then, I didn't think anything worthwhile would come of it...
Your ancestor is the Lorzub the Fierce... An ordinary orc, something between an animal and an intelligent creature... And he is called the Legendary Orc!
But the advantage of your race is that Sarn made you dumb enough so you'd act before you thought...
That's exactly what I need. Your intuition. You must think it's something ordinary... But your ability to predict the future will come in handy when we go on a journey through the worlds.
Star Gates do not forgive mistakes! When you become a Great Mage, you will be our guide... A navigator who sets the course!
Calm down. To be honest, your behavior disappoints me.
But I still respect your exploits, so as a sign of respect, I'll carry out the ritual in front of you. Perhaps that way you'll see that I don't want to harm you or Skulnar.
Just try not to distract me. This is very important...
It looks like the Hero of Sarnaut has handled everything as usual! Get over here and tell me what happened.
Yeah? It looks pretty quiet... Alright, let's go. I think we need to go straight ahead, and then turn left...
, I had very strange dreams... Dragons, their blood, other worlds...
Well, your stubbornness disrupted my concentration.
Ah, it's nice here, ... I had no idea you could relax this much without any alcohol!
That was a nice race, yeah? And the way I played Daguta? It was awesome!
Those elves will probably pester me to death with their research... I don't want to think about it.
Greetings! Allow me to introduce myself: Great Mage Elleken of the House de Velund, the First of the Great Mages of Sarnaut.
Must you complicate things? Are you that bored?
Fine, let me tell you a bit more about the ritual so you can calm down.
As you already know, we used dragon blood to become Great Mages. Sturegga was our first "donor".
One of the things about the ritual is that it can't be interrupted once the test subject has taken a sip of dragon blood. Either you take control of this power or you die.
My brother Pascal came up with his famous test. A Great Mage uses the power of dragon blood to master all elements one by one.
But everything begins with dragon blood. I'm using the Bond Lucretia was hastily trying to hide... The king gave it to me.
Oh, she woke up from the noise you're making. I have no time to put her in a trance again...
Although there's one way to draw her attention. I'm sure you won't let me down.

...the Architect who'd had the misfortune to take notice of your world. Sarn no longer existed, but I had...

So, some bloodsucking creature attacked the crew and overcame all of them...
Did someone aboard sabotage the beast smuggling operation? Strange, goblins are stupid, but not that stupid...
Hmm... I need to think about everything in the fresh air and put it all together.
So, here is what we know...  Some goblins under Kork’s command decided to go catch some leper animals.

@20.en: They couldn’t do that on Umoir, but then they remembered that the Drowsy Wood island not too far away. They didn’t know that island has been quarantined for some time now.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The entire team was killed and sucked dry of blood. Obviously, that thing was a vampire. A very, very strong and hungry one...
Their hunt was successful but, apparently, someone or something intelligent secretly boarded their ship and freed the animals at some point to create chaos...

@20.en: ! It's been a long time since I ran after someone... It’s a good thing I caught you here.
Well, what do we do now? We could scrap  it...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Not just the ship, a creature also crawled out of it and scared Mitya. He’s completely speechless, poor guy...
Well, let’s begin. First, we add Leper Madness Extract to give it the right acidity.

@20.en: Good! Now mix together Leper Growth Extract and Leper Variability Extract.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It's ready!

@20.en: Now we combine all three ingredients. Don't worry, it won’t explode! If you do it right...
Great! For the second potion, we’ll add the Catalyst to the mix. If you’re using a catalyst, you need to add the next ingredient quickly.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Finally, add a little more Leper Growth Extract.

@20.en: Now Leper Growth Extract and more Catalyst!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Good! Now we take Leper Madness Extract and Leper Variability Extract and mix them with the Catalyst.

@20.en: Almost done! Mix Leper Madness Extract with Leper Growth Extract.
We had more Catalyst and mix Leper Variability Extract with Leper Growth Extract.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We’re done! Now you know everything and making the third potion will be easy for you.
First we take Leper Variability Extract and Leper Growth Extract and mix them with the Catalyst.

@20.en: Now add Leper Madness Extract and the Catalyst and, to improve the reaction, add Leper Growth Extract.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: And there is your third potion!

@20.en: Oh! No problem, let’s try again. Just follow my instructions, okay?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Oh! I warned you not to confuse the ingredients! Now we have to mix everything again...
I’m afraid Annette is more of a beast than an elf now... Going that long without fresh blood causes madness. It would be merciful to...
No, Zayan! I know what you're getting at, and no matter how old I am, I won’t allow it... She's my only daughter! She’s all I have left!
Quiet, both of you. Once again, you’re making decisions about something you don’t understand. It’s a difficult situation, but not hopeless. I do have one idea...
! While we discuss Roxane’s ideas, go see what happened across that bridge.
As I said... Not the best place for an elf tomb, but it’s harder to find here than in some of the most dangerous parts of Sarnaut.
I feel like Zayan enjoys sending me on missions. In any case, this mission is surprisingly simple.
The vampires have gone completely mad. They locked themselves inside Amarantha and are plotting some secret business. All this with the locals’ assisstance. That works to our advantage.
Even animals used to be afraid to travel in these parts, but now we can scout everything out without any problems.
We need to examine everything that looks even a little suspicious. This could all be an illusion... Or there is just a stone covering the entrance. Or an illusion of a stone.
Yes! There’s the entrance... I’ll bet it leads to more twisted Umoir catacombs.
Wow, the vampires worked hard to make this place less... Abandoned looking. Are they sleeping or something?

@20.en: It only works to our advantage right now. Let’s try not to alert them... The Key is here.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Are they... asleep? Their rituals are very unusual. We know so little about the magnificent creatures.
I know you’re a hero, but we need to run now! The Queen is incredibly strong right now!
Excellent, this is our chance... I’ll try to grab their Key as quietly as possible.
Your mission is to not let anyone interfere. They’re in a trance, of course, but someone will surely wake up.

@20.en: Worms-on-faces come and die! Now more meatbag stranger come! Also die! They die!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Strange... I expected some kind of welcome, but everything seems dead...
In any case, if there is anything here, it will be at the center of the island. Ever been here?
You can’t get lost here, but we should be careful. I don't believe the draconids only left a few squads here...
There! Look how it blossoms with joy... Perfect!

@20.en: A gruesome fate... I will go to the Keepers and ask them for help getting the animals out of here. See you there.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Don’t fear, little creature, I will save you all... I will bring everyone home...
Let's go on! Anger the demon even more to test its power on the corpse!
Get him really angry so he uses his dark magic!
Well. This is dangerous. Eloise and our deceased friend must experience deadly magic. Everyone ready?
I’m ready. I hope you can stop this creature if something goes wrong.
As I expected. You can’t find a creature’s Spark if there isn’t one! Too bad, the zombie didn’t make it...
Let's go on! Make the demon angrier to test his power on Eloise!
Oh, there are so many ghosts here... I’ll move to the former central camp at the top of the hill, and you try to get there carefully and investigate the area along the way. We’ll rendezvous there.
These places... so many memories! So many important events happened here!
As you found out, now this whole place is Nihaz’s abandoned theater. It seems he hasn’t been here for some time.
That works to our advantage. I plan to investigate the towns at the very heart of Gipat and find... Something.
Sounds vague, especially considering we are dealing with a divine being...
But, in the end, we’re just trying to break something! And after that the wisdom of Urd will take care of everything.
So, you’ll have to handle the investigation while I prepare the ritual.
Creepy and calm. On the one hand, Gipat is very consistent, nothing changes here year after year, but that consistency... It’s unnatural.
Didn’t that worry the ancient necromancers? In this war we’ll have to do without excessive moralism. At least we’ll give them the chance take revenge on their captor.
You’re not used to this yet? The idea here is the same as always – we need to hide our plans from both Nihaz and the rest of the world.
First, as usual, we use the magiscope, and then... Look for something strange. See, Gipat simply can’t be free of mysteries.
So that’s on you. All this time there hasn’t been anything you couldn't break. This mission is about improvisation, so improvise!
That’s it, let’s go... Please don’t bother me with words. Just enjoy the nature.
This isn’t over, Hiero, can’t you see? You may stop us, but who will stop them?

@20.en: Lose? I do have something lose, Zayan... You consider yourself wise, but where do you lead those who follow you? Are you sure you aren’t dancing to a Dark God's tune?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hiero, are you blinded by duty? We are not doing this for ourselves! Each of us is sacrificing much! Don’t you have something to lose?! Wake up!

@20.en: Damnation! Fine, this time I’ll trust you... Templars, lay down your weapons!
First peace with demons, then with architects, and now undead... what is happening to Sarnaut?
I knew the elves would lead us astray...  Would a decent priest do makeup?
Yeah, when you die, they turn you into a zombie just like that and force you to work...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I'd sure like to be on Catherina’s ship!

@20.en: They say a great united Convocation is coming. The churches of the Empire and the League are uniting! They’re even doing away with the anathemas!
How is old Forox, dwelling of the Light? I can remember my hometown, our Cathedral, Brother Ivan, and the statue of Saint Brian...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Who is the Prioress on Umoir? Ah yes, it's Hope Brightley...

@20.en: My line has ruled Kania for thousands of years! There is no mercy for betraying House de Doucer!
Wow, what a welcome you have prepared for me... But I am not here to chat, Wigo.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: These cowards around me don’t help anymore. They are too afraid of your power. And I’m clever enough to know I cannot win this fight.

@20.en: Then what? To kill? You have always been a monster. It’s in your blood. And I was always above that.
All I can say is that our little friend still knows how to choose patrons. Time for me to find some stronger allies... See you around.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You can’t hide your cowardice behind theatrics, Wigo... Oh, what a pitiful sight.

@20.en: Apparently, there are no strong vampires left, if Wigo was the only one worthy of leading the others in my absence.
I know you're hoping for a fight, but that won’t happen. Wigo is too scared to fight me. Other vampires won’t dare stand against me.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Okay, come now, there are more problems to solve... Now comes the moment of triumph and greatness. For me, of course. You get to watch.
I must admit, you did good work. Both to help me and to save the world you know from this Nihaz.
There is no time to wait for Reniesta’s next move. We need to begin the ritual.
Remember, I will be incredibly vulnerable until the ritual is over. So... please try to keep us alive.
Obviously, I understood everything immediately, but I gave you a chance to figure it out without me.
Watch our flanks. I doubt Reniesta will be happy that we solved her puzzle...
Why did you go over to that ghost merchant? That salve won’t make anything bigger...
Ghosts certainly know a tale or two... Just don't tell the others, okay?
This hole is halfway, of course... Did you also not hear the pebble drop?
SILENCE! You've come too far! Why are you here? Why do you disturb those long passed? They fought enough in life!
I have infinite respect for the heroes of Umoir, Reniesta, but we are forced to do this so we can...
I don't want to know anything about it. The problems of the living have not concerned us for some time. You must go, whether you want to or not.
I am not that stupid. I know you are strong. I will not fight you. Not here and not like that. But I will stop you with mind, not strength.

@684.en: NO! I will not let you both defile this place with your sorcery! First I will crush your protector and then you, Dakkar!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I’ll keep one for my experiments. I can't wait to test the improved formula!
First, yolu need to solve the problem with the energy supply!
Oh, Tep! What happened this time?! Hurry, run to the captain! We won’t last long without cannons!

@20.en: Whoa! Finally! That could have been faster...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Why are you just standing there? Go find the captain. The deck is probably crawling with demons!
They didn't damage anything important, so it shouldn't take me long to fix it.
Excellent! Now go help our forces on the port side! They could also use your help!
Oh, help doesn’t hurt! Hurry up and get behind the gun. Shoot everything you see!

@20.en: Look, shorty... If you’re lying... you’ll lose your head!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Something broke here. I need to even it out with a gouger. Hand it to me!
The small pincher won’t work on a big nail! I need the big one! Bring it to me!

@20.en: He did that to me last time... It hurt!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Why are you standing there, rookies? Go clean the droppings out of the hold! And I don’t want a single squirrel on board, or I’ll dump you in the astral!
That bastard killed my good buddy on a bridge. Made poor fellow quake at his name for three days after resurrecting...
...I don’t know what happened, but Cosmos must explain everything!

@20.en: The whirlpool will send you back in time exactly three days, nine hours, six minutes and twelve seconds.
I’m always ready. Move out!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You will appear on board Atreus. The team will help you. Ready?

@20.en: There was slaughter on the ship... We need to find out who did that.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I noticed that the bodies of the Zem weren't... changed. It’s strange.
The portal must charge, we'll have to wait. I hope the reactor can handle it.
Armed with the curse, the demons will wipe out everyone in their way.
We can't just wait for the new demons to enslave us all. We need to strike first.
Even if we gather an army, the darkness will corrupt them. Unless it's a Zem army or... just the undead.
Are you out of your mind, Historian? You can't just force hordes of the undead to follow your orders.
Not me. But I know someone who can control the undead.
Together we'll gather enough material and find a good site for his work...
Hm... Well... There's one place. It's dreadful but well-hidden. And, like you said, there's more than enough "material".
I could get it for you. If your Summoner is as good as you say, it will give us a chance at victory.
You'll do me an invaluable favor. I'll come as soon as I find the Summoner.
Good. But you'd better hurry. As soon as I find a way to remove the Seal, the army should be ready.
...We need more oak idols and game. And three brave workers.
Are you done? Great. So we can continue to disable generators... But talk to me first.
What a fight! You did it. Great. We need to discuss our course of action! Our further progress is impeded.
Excellent! Now we can rise above the one who controls everything here!
It's strange... I still sense unknown power. The feeling is stronger now.
I asked you to keep ghosts away from me! I'll have to start again!
The focus of summoning magic... This sphere feeds on souls drawn to this place from all parts of Veligrad.
I'll try to take control of the soul sphere, and you must protect me from anything that tries to disrupt the ritual.
Yes, Wislav... Gather a circle of guardians.  We will perform a restoration ritual tonight.
Tonight? But... I thought we planned to do it at the time of the new moon?
Junior apprentices don't need to worry about that. This ritual is for the senior circle only.
One of my apprentices. She has always been too curious. For her own good.
Quiet...! We won't have another chance... We need to tell the sister.
Sisters always stuck together, whispering among themselves. Grumpida, Crankida... There was another sister.
Galenel made it clear they didn't need us there.
I saw great potential in them. But I underestimated their ambition.
Wislav, Galenel sent me. She asks you to deliver this letter to Plagot as soon as possible.
I don’t know... She was in a hurry and didn't want to be bothered. It must be something urgent.
Hm... Well, if it's urgent, then give it here. I hope Galenel finds someone to stand in for me during the ritual.
Let's talk later? I need to prepare for the ritual. I have an important place in the Circle.
I don’t understand... What about Charmeye and Svetozara? The ritual is starting soon, and our Circle still has empty spots.
I haven't seen them. But don't worry, I'm sure they'll turn up soon...
She lied to my face. I was in a hurry and couldn't see what was right under my nose.

@28.en: False Charmeye

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You are so clever, sisters! It's time for a little masquerade...
All done. Wislav won't be back from Plagot until dawn.
Svetozara is still here but she has a... mucus problem.
I can't believe it! These wretched girls fooled me with some primitive spell...!
There you are! The ritual is about to start, why aren't you here already?
GOT IT! We broke all soul seals! I'll destroy whatever's left...
Look! In the circle in the center of the door! See? We need crusaders' souls to break this seal.
You are forgetting yourself, old summoner! Remember how our last meeting ended? Let the elf go or I'll remind you!

@20.en: Giving me orders now, little dead sorceress? Ha ha... You lost power over it when you were still alive.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: And yes... Thank you, Galenel, for bringing him here to me.

@20.en: I noticed this talented summoner as soon as he touched my Scroll.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It's too late, Galenel. Now leave me. I must finish...
Be careful with this scroll. Who knows what other dangers are hidden in it.
I started it?! Who do you think planned all this? You'd have nothing without me!
That day the guardians were going to strengthen the protective spell...
Everything is ready for the ritual, only Wislav and others are missing. They are never late...
Forgive us, brothers and sisters! We had urgent business to tend do. He he...
Let's start! I can't wait to... protect this scroll with our magic.

@20.en: They seem to be in a deep trance... Shall we begin?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Some things shouldn't be hurried, Charmeye. One of the greatest relics of Yazes is before us - the scroll of Urd, the Soul Eater...
We must exercise caution. Let's start with focusing our consciousness. Free your mind and let the magic fill you...
That's it, let's get the horses ready. I need to get back before nightfall!
Well, that's Jade! He sells the best wine to ghouls, but we get nothing. Take it and tell him to go live with the bloodsuckers if he loves them so much.
Oh, damn... hiccup! It was a treat, so I... hiccup...! accepted it. Take the bottle and don't tell anyone I had it... hiccup!
It says "Red Hightown wine - 25 pcs." on the box, but there are only 17 left, and two got broken. Where's the rest?!
Homespun fabrics, seven pieces... So there should be seven, but there are only four on the cart!

@20.en: Moon was rising, it was calm and peaceful... When will I finish my poem?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Where are you going? Off to visit your bloodsuckers?

@20.en: No, I don't intend to die!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: What are you doing lurking around the village? You've occupied our tavern - so stay there.
What, cat got your tongue?

@20.en: Milosh is not here, it's his day off. Check the tavern.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Milosh? Why would he be here? He's probably on guard duty on the shore.
Princess Svetlana! Alive...! Don't mind that I'm... hiccup...! in this state...

@20.en: Eloise de Doucer: Finally, the night sky...!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Eloise de Doucer: You'll never understand how much it costs us - our oath to stay away from humans.

@20.en: Eloise de Doucer: The village is sleeping peacefully… So much sweet warm blood...!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Eloise de Doucer: If it hadn't been for you, I would've broken my word and slaughtered everyone in that house.
I haven't fed the ghoul for a week. She's so hungry she's ready to gnaw on the cage bars.
They'll see. I'll give a signal when I let her out. You'll sound the alarm, and we'll start hunting.

@20.en: It's dark enough now. We should start while the locals are asleep.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You've done well. The locals are convinced they're in danger. Soon they'll see it with their own eyes.
Did you see the way they cornered de Delice near the tavern?

@20.en: After tonight, she and her retinue will have to make a hasty departure.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: If they don't, I'll have a talk with Lovvie - she'll spread the word.
Oh yes, your rumor of the vampire went around quickly, the locals are grabbing their stakes and pitchforks.
Unless someone stops us. Today someone took down my amulets and dispersed the bullies. It's outrageous.
That's not good. We can't let the princess down, she's counting on us.
Don't worry, no one will ruin her plans. How is our "guest", Obrad?
Ready to go for a walk, bloodsucker? That can be arranged!
We drove it away from Wellebell but the lands in the north are still afflicted.
But we're still a long time away from total victory over the Blight. The Valley is beyond those trees.
Thank you! We need to get back to work before the mentor finds out...
Oh... I tried to run away but it was too late. Don't tell Alfred, alright?
No more loitering in the ruins, warriors! New duty awaits you!
Did you listen to my cries when I was burned at the stake by the Inquisition...?
And you, sister... Why are you so kind to the traitor? Don't you share my pain? That's fine. I'll show you...

@20.en: Do you remember the bright years of your life?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I remember the fire burning my skin until it turned to ash!
Until he is gone forever, none of us will find peace!

@20.en: I was young and full of empty ambition, and the call of duty drowned out the voice of my heart!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Come, darling. I'll grant you eternal peace.

@20.en: I couldn't fade away because I knew I wronged you. I won't find peace unless you forgive me.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Sweetheart...

@20.en: I craved your love... Then your blood... But now I only want... peace...
Go back to the elf now. Let's see what your summoner can do.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I hope all bones are accounted for? Or else the result will be... unpleasant.
Keep going, don't get distracted. Or you'll mix up body parts.
Touch the soul imprint, and you will see where the ghost headed next.
Sweet, tasty bones... lovely bones...
Move, soldiers! Go to the Flooded Garden and don't stop anywhere!

@20.en: Wonderful! With this blood, we can finally... Wait, who is that with you?!
Some idiot who walks around smelling random things... We'll kill him later, leave him for now. And you go stand over there, girl. I'm reading the plants...
I'm sorry, I didn't know...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There are defects and issues, of course... But enough about that. Let's test it.

@20.en: Quiet! None of this matters anymore. You heard them... at that gathering.
Genevieve, off with you. I'll be brief. Today I realized that humans will never accept us. We must get stronger.
You repaired our cloning equipment, and thanks to Genevieve, we can use it for a good cause.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Go, clone.

@20.en: This is our first triumph. A clone that follows orders and costs little to produce.
It's nothing personal. You are on our enemy's side, even though I'm grateful for everything you've done.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Amarantha is closed. Get rid of these demonstrators first.

@20.en: ...Blighted wolves are stronger than other wolves but they are not their enemies...
...Blighted hares are more fertile but more subdued and omnivorous...
...There is no sickness the Blight can't cure...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: ...No one should fear the Blight - it's here to make us stronger...

@20.en: ...We know that animals want to be turned, but the druids are against it...
Take care, these are troubled times.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It's great that you fixed those cloning devices... Maybe they'll give me a partner!
That story with the witch! You are tougher than I thought!

@20.en: It's nice and peaceful here...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You walk around all day, all night... huh? Who is there?

@20.en: No one saw him lurking, but everyone knew a war was on; they were afraid...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You should finish your business in Amarantha and leave.

@20.en: It's foolish and dangerous, I shouldn't do it. Or even consider it.
Come on, boys! Show him why witches are feared!
Your flesh is probably too tough, but your heart must be delicious!
You were right, sisters! There are black wings over the world!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ah, I remember that girl! She was so tasty, deep-fried with a mushroom sauce!
What?! It can't be! Don't touch me, or you'll regret it!

@20.en: Get out while you can. If you cause trouble, my boys will rip you apart!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There's the one who killed my sisters! I knew you were coming, so I made preparations...

@20.en: Little Frogs... No idea what it's about...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: A Brief History of Art, Volume 18... It's too bad I don't have other volumes.

@20.en: Funny Facts You Shouldn't Know... It's too bad I don't have time.
Transcendental Apperception... Must be a real page-turner...
Of Love and Evil: The Minds of Cecilia... What a mysterious story. No time to read, the world needs saving...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Center of the Moon... Interesting...
Edward...! I'll read this letter in the shade of a tree on a sunny day...
When will he realize that a dead hare in a box is a bad gift?

@20.en: Reya the Merciless: Hey you! Who are you? There are no weaklings like you in our gang!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hey, buddy! Are you local, by chance?
Hey you! Who are you? There are no weaklings like you in our gang!

@28.en: Hey, come here. Don't stare. Only you can see me. We need to talk. It is very important!

@20.en: Damn it! The ship is under extreme overload, braking is impossible!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Shipbell the Mariner: Hold on to something! Don't panic!
Igor Mackin:Damn it! The ship is under extreme overload, braking is impossible!

@20.en: Damn it! The ship is under extreme overload, braking is impossible!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Vsevolod Kuznetsov: Brace yourself! No panic.
Gleb Puskarev: Damn it! The ship is under extreme overload, braking is impossible!
Ay-hya! Today you all will die! And your life depends on how you will face your death.
Many of you didn't live to see this day. The world has taken their tya to give it another birth in the eternal circle. Today you will have to die, too, eysh!
You all look into the face of death brravely. Each day, each moment it stands behind your backs. Today my disciples will die, and trrue Pridens will take their places!
You are destined to follow in your ancestors' wake; to learn what death is and find your place in the harmony of life, eysh!
We will feast on your bones! Your days are numbered! Scar will be our new leader!

@28.en: Sca-a-ar! Don't leave me! I am your friend! They will tear me to pieces! Help!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Sca-a-ar! Don't leave me! I am your friend! They will tear me to pieces! Help!

Akkya failed and cannot be your leader anymore! Now he's a Dead Wolf.

I, Scar, declare myself the leader! Will anyone dare to challenge my right? Maybe you, Mirrah? Or you, Belly, you old sack of fleas?
Hey, kylys! Stop wrecking the dummy! You want to get a little exercise, zoor? I can dance the dance of claws with you!
Enough! I can see you are strrong. Sorry for hurting you. Go to your Trainer, he will help you heal the wound.
Aagh! Help! They are killing faithful Baccy! Scar, save me! Sca-a-ar!

@28.en: I can hear Akkya's howling. The Pack Council begins! Follow me to the Council Rock!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Many things in the forest are not what they appear. See that squirrel? It looks harmless, but actually it's quite the opposite. Its teeth are even bigger than mine. It can bite your paw off if you get distracted!
You are cruel, Tynil... I can still hear their joyful yelping when they first saw the sunlight...

@28.en: You are cruel, Tynil... I can still hear their joyful yelping when they first saw the sunlight...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Alright, cub. You are not of our blood, but in the memory of the children of me and Tynil I will spare your life. Walk away!

@28.en:
Aargh! Tynil, have you lost your mind?!

Don't be too happy. I will get back to you!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Well, well, here's my runaway breakfast. You didn't touch my prey? That's a wise decision, Itkan... You could have made me really angry!

@28.en: Well, well, here's my runaway breakfast. You didn't touch my prey? That's a wise decision, Itkan... You could have made me really angry!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Wait, Itkan! Don't touch the cub!

Aargh! Tynil, have you lost your mind?!

Don't be too happy. I will get back to you!

@28.en: How dare you come here, you brute? This cub is ours! Go away, murderer!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Look at him, Itkan! He's so scared and vulnerable. Remember our cubs? They were just as weak and helpless!
How dare you come here, you brute? This cub is ours! Go away, murderer!
I can hear Akkya's howling. The Pack Council begins! Follow me to the Council Rock!

Listen and remember, cub. Deers are weak and timid. Tasty meat, easy to kill, but not so easy to catch. Upon smelling a hunter, it tails away. Run it till it's exhausted and then sink your teeth into its thin neck! It's your prey!

Text.en: Listen and remember, cub. Deers are weak and timid. Tasty meat, easy to kill, but not so easy to catch. Upon smelling a hunter, it tails away. Run it till it's exhausted and then sink your teeth into its thin neck! It's your prey!

@28.en: Foxes are sly rascals. They often steal food from the real hunters, though can be easily scared away. Be careful, their bites are really painful!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Foxes are sly rascals. They often steal food from the real hunters, though can be easily scared away. Be careful, their bites are really painful!

Text.en: Many things in the forest are not what they appear. See that squirrel? It looks harmless, but actually it's quite the opposite. Its teeth are even bigger than mine. It can bite your paw off if you get distracted!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: A boar is a bad prey. It tastes good, but only the best hunters can kill it. One little mistake - and it rips your stomach with its fearsome tusks! Be careful, cub!

@28.en:
Watch your mouth, Scar! I may be old but I still have enough strength to tear at your throat!

Itkan and Tynil have spoken their word. I have spoken mine. Now the Pack will speak!

Well, who will speak for the wolf cub?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Listen to me, Pack! This cub is my prey. By the law of forest I demand you give it back to me!
A prey? You are lying, Scar. This cub has eyes of a hunter and a fearless heart. He will be a part of the Pack!

@28.en: A prey? You are lying, Scar. This cub has eyes of a hunter and a fearless heart. He will be a part of the Pack!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Watch your mouth, Scar! I may be old but I still have enough strength to tear at your throat!

Itkan and Tynil have spoken their word. I have spoken mine. Now the Pack will speak!

Well, who will speak for the wolf cub?
Listen to me, Pack, and don't say you haven't been told! The young cub calls himself a hunter. Who else thinks he is one?

@28.en: Listen to me, Pack, and don't say you haven't been told! The young cub calls himself a hunter. Who else thinks he is one?

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
The Pack has spoken!

Now we are of one blood, young wolf cub! Scar, it is not your prey!

Text.en:
The Pack has spoken!

Now we are of one blood, young wolf cub! Scar, it is not your prey!

@28.en: You are old and foolish, Akkya... We'll see who's the hunter, and who's the prey!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Wait, Scar... I will speak for the cub! Right before the Council I slaughtered a bull and hid the corpse in the bushes by the river. Its meat will prove my words - I can feel this cub is going to become a real hunter!

Text.en: Wait, Scar... I will speak for the cub! Right before the Council I slaughtered a bull and hid the corpse in the bushes by the river. Its meat will prove my words - I can feel this cub is going to become a real hunter!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Go your own way, you outgrown wasp... The cub will become a hunter, I'm the oldest bear in the forest and I'm telling you that!
I asssent. You know me well, Sscar... You shouldn't put my word to the tesst!

@28.en: I asssent. You know me well, Sscar... You shouldn't put my word to the tesst!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Who cares about this foundling? Akkya, enough with the chatter, I'm hungry! I will leave the bottom half for you!

Text.en: Listen to me, Pack! This cub is my prey. By the law of forest I demand you give it back to me!

@28.en:
Akkya, Akkya... You are old and foolish. Why would you accept such a parody of a hunter to the Pack? It's a mockery of our laws!

Why are you silent, Pack? Speak your word!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Akkya, Akkya... You are old and foolish. Why would you accept such a parody of a hunter to the Pack? It's a mockery of our laws!

Why are you silent, Pack? Speak your word!

Text.en: Who cares about this foundling? Akkya, enough with the chatter, I'm hungry! I will leave the bottom half for you!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You are old and foolish, Akkya... We'll see who's the hunter, and who's the prey!
Down! Hurry! And watch your feet!

@20.en: Down! Hurry! And watch your feet!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Water... Water! Give me...

Ah, what am I saying?! Don't listen to me, bring water to Radovid. There are some who need water much more than I do...
Hey, look! It's a wounded Hunter. We've got to help him!
Well, thank you, but I'd rather have some engine oil.

I was on Winter Watch,

 The Urun came like a storm,

 And when I hid in the snow,

 Glorious warriors saved Gerda!
What are you looking at? She's like ice! Need more fire, eysh!
I can see trees over there. You can collect firewood there.
He who enters the mist will find only what he brought with him. Caw!
Caw! Cold ice burns with a ghostly flame in the rays of the setting sun.
Caw! Icy winds carry bitter news from the mountain slopes covered with dead stone.
Yarna the Pipe - yes, this is my grandmother. She lived in 980 of the new era. Great skald! I take after her!
Mauni the Dancer... and this is... my great-great-grandmother. Her Thread broke in 938.
Sigus the Long Mustache… Great-great-great-great… and maybe one more “great-” grandfather. He was a warden in Skalgard. Left the Pattern in 885.
Vetri the Skier - he went around the whole of Isa. Also my ancestor - and it’s scary to say in what generation. His Fate came about in 841.
Driva the White Braid was a brave warrior. She went on an eternal journey after the battle with the Urun! It was... in 823.
It's… very unexpected. But I think I can guess where my ancestors came from.

Betrayed his oath

You, the last wanderer!

Go away! Into exile

Beyond the Bear Ridge!

Chained for centuries

At the origins of the clan,

The spirit of the leader

Must not break free!

@28.en: Broddie Stalwart: Just as before, the Urun were no match for the bravery of the Gibberlings!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Broddie Stalwart: Well, we're victorious again!

@28.en: Broddie Stalwart: A new age of Isa begins, and we will reconnect with our lost brothers and sisters!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Broddie Stalwart: So let us raise our cups to that!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: To arms, Gibberlings! Let's rally as one and destroy these impudent cats!
After all, the Thread of the victim always turns out to be connected to the killer!
My destiny was to defeat the miserable tribes of humans, but my victory was simply taken away from me!
Unable to deal with me in open battle, my enemies sent a vile assassin after me!
But I found a way to reclaim my destiny! Now I just need to leave this island...
When I come back, I can restore the true order of things. I will avenge the descendants of those who interrupted my path...
Through space, the call of my Horde reaches me. They are waiting for Chief Skulnar to lead them again.
I knew it would happen. I immediately felt that you have true power!

@20.en: I think we'll meet again sometime... this time in the flesh!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Let's continue our fight!
For your children. They will help you. We will call upon the forces from beyond this world, the forces of the gods that fought Hirkalla. They will free you. There is hope.
Remember that no matter what happens, no matter how fate changes, you will always be welcome here on Isa.

@28.en: The wise say that waters once covered most of the world...
But there are monsters in the deep abyss, and one of the most insidious among them was Lyngbakr.
This fish was huge, and when it surfaced, its back was like an island!
Sensing the living, Lyngbakr plunged into the abyss, then devoured his drowning victims!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Does the eye of the one dressed in black feathers see the one named a "friend" by the branch hopper?

@20.en: Oh… What? Some nonsense!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
The bones were fish,

The fish lived in the sea,

Saw Lyngbakr

And his fate!

@20.en:
He clings to the bottom,

Senses that his time is coming

He will become prey

And rise above the abyss...!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Brothers! All aboard! Let's do what no one has done before!

@20.en: You stayed on!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
The island was empty,

Only ice and fire.

The Ash Tree shot up

With its crown to the skies.

customData/text.en: You have found enough items. Time to clean and identify them!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Like the feathers of a raven, black are the thoughts of one feared by death itself. Caw!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Kharyskhan: Fear me, Gibberlings, for I am your nightmare who came from the darkness of ages! Remember this day!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There is less life in your world, but its power is amazing. They are stronger than you think.

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: To send the bees to collect nectar, you need to have all of them nearby.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: In the spruce forest, the cones sing about the day when the sun sets in the east. Caw!
Uh! Most importantly... our secret ingredient! I'm glad I didn’t forget... What Surt Junior gave me!
Phew, it looks like everything is ready. Now it should sit for a bit... but if your wooden girlfriend can speed up the process, then I hope she will help us here, too?
It's not just mead! This is true art, the secrets of which were kept by our ancestors.
It's an honor to participate in the brewing of mead, so be thankful to these wanderers that we're doing it a second time this year! And now - let's brew mead!
We can speak with the goddess! I can sense that the Tree has its own mind and its thoughts are linked with hers. But it won't be easy...
Aho, friend! I'm still glad to see you in this hour of shared misfortune. Welcome to Howlem, my homeland.
Clear your mind, strengthen it! There is nothing faster than thought! With its help, we will be transported...

@1188.en: Thanks for your help, wanderer. May your hand be strong, and may it protect the weak.

@28.en: Ekhe-Hoor: Thanks for your help, wanderer. May your hand be strong, and may it protect the weak.

@1188.en: I bow to you, guest. May your wisdom be like the full moon that shines bright in the darkness.

@28.en: Makchirgue: I bow to you, guest. May your wisdom be like the full moon that shines bright in the darkness.

@1188.en: Praise be to you, wanderer. May your paths be as light as the paths of the wind.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It… woke up. Ratatoskr! The squirrel that jumps between the branches of the Great Ash Tree.
You were fast as lightning, but now you are fast asleep, Val. I'm sorry.
You have seen the peaks of the highest mountains, but eternal dreams have seized you, Orn. I'm sorry.
It beats like a heart... But we need more power, otherwise I won’t be able to pull it out.
It's been a while since I've had a chance to jump using Vegvisir. I hope we get there without any problems, but be ready for anything, little friends.
Isa is not such a big island now. But there are plenty of wild lands.
Isa has always been more harsh than the rest of the world. So the animals here are meaner.
It's not just the Werebears. But other creatures, too! Some don't even have a name.
We also have lots of different creatures on the Frozen Frontier. Yes, and whatever's in the Astral.

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: If you don't fall into the abyss, the wind will throw you off, or an avalanche will sweep you away.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: So that's how it all happened! Brus's blood helped find Isa...
That's why no one could find Isa! The Thread Keepers hid it well.
A sad story. It's a pity that this happened. But there was no other choice...
Did you really think there is anyone on Isa who can stop me?
You are surrounded by my warriors, so you have no choice! Give me those Gibberlings!
Do not dishonor the Priden people! Fight in a fair duel!
The fun is over! I said, that's enough! Disperse. Or should I explain it some other way?
Follow my instructions. The rest is irrelevant.
Calm down! He's a friend!
Hey, Broddie, what do you have there? Who's this hairy guy?

That's how Isa was born.

And the Gibberlings with it.

Ase and Emla,

Weaved from branches.

Families multiplied,

Isa became crowded!

Boats go out to seas,

Foreign seas.

But the custom was followed,

And the young sprouts

Returned to the Tree

To keep watch.

Orcs from across the sea

Invaded our lands.

We defended the Tree

To our last breath!

@20.en:
Void creatures

Came at night.

Forgetting fear and grief,

We fought to save our Ash!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
An alliance was formed:

Heidruns, Zvergs,

Priden units.
.
The Orcs were expelled.

Peace was short-lived...

Our world was split,

And the seas were gone,

Families separated.

Our neighbors became

Our new misfortune,

Beasts in white skins

Came down the mountains like an avalanche.

@20.en:
No matter how many times

We defeated the cruel Urun,

The enemy returned,

As though possessed.

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Century after century, a secret

Was unraveled by the Spinners,

That the Urun are lead into battle

By an immortal leader.

You, messengers of the Abyss,

Broke their spells!

Kharyskhan is free!

Trouble is coming!

Threads tell me

What I should see.

What the pattern tells us

Must be done.
Well, let's see what you've got! Don't look at our size - we defeated a Jotunn once!
Oh, great! We've already fought everyone else on the island!
We are close to solving this mystery. I can feel it! The one who steals destinies is close.
He's in a hurry. He has a plan and he's about to execute it. But we can still get to him!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: We are close to solving this mystery. I can feel it! The one who steals destinies is close.
The last fate was rewritten just recently! Follow the Thread you see
Now he's an "odd man out", thrown out of his own fate... What will he do? We'll find out soon.
He's in a hurry. He has a plan and he's about to execute it. But we can still get to him!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The psychological method should be effective here.

@20.en: ...all were to perish, except for a few chosen ones...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Get up, we're almost there...

@20.en: ...world was condemned to a terrible new strange plague...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: That's enough drinking!

@20.en: Help me, my servants!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hey, policeman! See who I have here with me? Will you leave me alone now?
There was a time I could make merry all day long!

@908.en: Don't worry about Sonya, I'll help her...

@1084.en: The thing is, I'm well acquainted with Rodion Raskolnikov. I've been watching him for a while...

@908.en: We always imagine eternity as an idea that is impossible to comprehend.

@1084.en: Something enormous! But why does it have to be enormous?

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: It's unpleasant, yes. We have a riot here, all thanks to one person we both know, and I'm asking you for help again.
A blind man and a madman, you make quite a pair! You can't beat me!

@564.en: Here she is! The Scissors we've been looking for!

@740.en: I know how to stop her! But you'll have to distract her!

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: If everyone has a destiny, then she has one too! Let's tie her with her own Threads!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I warned you all, but no one listened to me. I told you you were heading straight into the trap of the Dark God.
He is cunning, as an owl is cunning in the night. He lies in wait for you on many paths, and very few of those are straight paths.
Everything you have done, everything you have devised - he knew about it in advance, for his capabilities are not the capabilities of mortals, but the powers of God.
He persuaded you to do what he wanted with false promises, he put tools in your hands so you could forge your own chain...

@20.en: Thank you! Light is shining into my soul!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Now my brothers and I are defending this Cathedral with the power of our Faith. There is Darkness around it. Her Darkness.

@20.en: We looked for the Light, but Darkness came instead!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Darkness is fighting the Light here, and people's hearts are the battlefield.
Praise the Light! I thought you'd never wake up! Everyone knows you should stay away from dark creatures.
Let's bring three at once, it's too much walking bringing one at a time...
Stop it! Enough! Enough! That's enough dogs! I can barely feed the ones I have.

@20.en: Ah, I feel the taste of food again! The ripple of water and the rustle of grass! It's nice to be alive!
It's the damned elf, the bastard! Come here, you moron!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Praise the Light! Death to Darkness!
What of it? Dead souls? If there is a product, there is a buyer. It's completely legal these days.
I didn't collect them just to give them away! They are mine!
Cheats! Swindlers everywhere!
Voice in the head: Can you hear me, worm? I remember you... You won't catch me off-guard, won't steal my Spark again!
Voice in the head: I went through centuries of torment, but now it's your turn... I told you, your time will come.
I hope you remember how to kill immortal insane Summoners?
It says here, "He was not of rank exalted, he was not of noble birth. He was bred among the people in the breast of Mother Earth..."
"He set out to teach the people freedom, love, equality."
It says here, "To exhort them to resistance. But to flee the penalty of the prison, whip and gallows, to a foreign land he went."
"While the people waited eager for his coming to rebel against their fate."
It says here, "To arise and crush the Tsardom and the nobles' vicious hate."
"To share all the wealth in common, and the antiquated thrall of the church, the home, and marriage to abolish once for all."

@20.en: Try combining Essence of Destruction and Essence of Creation.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Well, let's begin. First we add Essence of Destruction to begin the process of nigredo.

@20.en: Now combine all three reagents. Don't worry, it won't explode. If you don't mix them up...
Alright! Now we take Essence of Destruction and Essence of Death, then combine them with Essence of Creation.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Add Essence of Life while Essence of Creation is active!

@20.en: Almost done! Combine Essence of Destruction and Essence of Life.
Done! Now you know everything, so creating the third instrument shouldn't be too hard.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: First we take Essence of Death and Essence of Life, then combine them with Essence of Creation.

@20.en: Now add Essence of Destruction and Essence of Creation, then add Essence of Life to improve the reaction.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Let's add more Essence of Creation and combine Essence of Death withEssence of Life.

@20.en: What nonsense?! Well, never mind, let's try again. Just follow my instructions, will you?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I warned you not to mix up the reagents! Now we have to start anew...
The prototype was freed from its own fate and regained its memory.
Nezeb! Yasker betrayed...! Must report...! Oh... my head... Fate is a lie! Lie! Don't believe it! It's all deceit and conspiracy... conspiracy of spiders...
Unfortunately, we are not strong enough to keep him in this state for long...

@20.en: Now we need to test these tools on the control sample.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Amazing...
Nihilists all over the city are attacking the guard. We will overthrow Darkness today!
She brings only darkness! Well, if you are so fond of darkness - get out! Go and serve her!
The disgruntled awakened have already gathered near the Cathedral where the bulk of my sister's guard is.
I ordered my guard to set out - together we will quell this rebellion once and for all!

@28.en: Hirkalla: Who else are you going to use and deceive now? Neither the Light nor the crowd of these ungrateful parasites helped you...
Tep: An imperfect universe that will be remade. Your powers, the powers of the gods, must be mine...
Tep: Your existence is meaningless. Only I know the true plan. And now I will begin to execute it. All worlds will know the power of the GOD OF DEATH TEP!

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: Look what's happening... When the shield of faith cracked, the dark creatures became noticeably bolder...

@572.en: The warriors of light are now fighting with the guard, but it's the awakened ones who are suffering...

@1108.en: It's not first time something like this has happened, right? She has kept things from you before.

@1644.en: We found the third person whose fate was stolen. In the previous version of reality, he was a war hero, a famous commander. Let's see who he is now.

@636.en: These ghosts were promised final resurrection, but that promise was never fulfilled.

@1172.en: Alice wants chaos in her sister's domain: she's using you and everyone else to achieve her ends.

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: For the ruler Hirkalla! Death to the rebels!
We never have enough people here, but as the commandant I have to look after the Forticia.
There he is, the man you were looking for. Pechorin is a fine fellow, albeit an odd one.
Ah, what a rhino! A fine one! If I were the master of the house and had a herd of three hundred rhinos, I would give half of them for such a steed!
Tell Pechorin that our agreement has been fulfilled! I said I would do it, so it shall be done!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Sometimes friends are worse than enemies. Enemies are more honest, but friends like this will cut our throats at night and disappear. I love enemies, but not friends.
Well, let's talk. They're complaining about you here, saying you stole from someone again.
A lie, you say? We saw your rhino - it's quite remarkable.
That's a lie! We were nowhere near it. We went south, to the old city.
True, there's no one like it. But we were in the south, I swear it...
You lost too much blood... But at least you got your revenge.
Ah, you! It's all your fault! Why are you helping him? You'll pay for everything!
To none has my love brought happiness, but who knows what will happen? What must be will be. Find her.
We are under attack! To arms, warriors! Let the enemy remember this day!
We should hurry if we don't want to meet all of Ammer here.
I need to collect some more. I hope you can hold off the enemies for a little longer.
Great, now we can leave this place. The Well is still full, so I think Cosmos should have no reason to be upset. I didn't take all the energy after all.
The first one is down! The enemy knows we are here now. Be careful!
I'm getting ready to take off. The Sculptor is going to wake up now, and we'll be overrun. We just need to hold on for a minute!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Perfect! The Well's power should be more than enough. But I don't want to be interrupted - let the jinns put up a protective barrier!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: This place is creepy. Smells like dead flesh in there... We should look around...
Gray Prince: The Architects have a decent ship. I think I've figured out how to use it.
Gray Prince: I'm going to unlock the scout swarm controls - use them wisely.
Gray Prince: There are too many of them! Teleport me to Hirkalla. Now!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Hirkalla: The Light has suffered another defeat, and we got two mages for the price of one. It's a great day. We are going back to Jigran.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hirkalla: Nihaz's Seal. Only Nezeb can reinhabit his own body. While I'm busy with the ritual, I can't be distracted - so make sure no one interrupts me.
Hmm... A terrible murder! The father of the family was killed, the accused is his own son! What is the reason? The mistress or money?
Hmm. A funny incident: the widow of the doctor who shot himself opened a sewing workshop where she gathered women who had run away from their families and began to live as a community!

@20.en: Wanted: Seven peasants who fled their villages, allegedly for the purpose of conducting a sociological survey. What changes await us?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I can't stand change! I'm tired of all this bustle.
Empty thoughts and desires... Running here and there, to ten places in one day - what kind of life is this?
Begone! He's mine! He will give me everything...
Thanks to you, Light entered my life, became protection and support. Let it be the same for you...

@420.en: You will pay for your willfulness! Everything will ultimately submit to the dictates of Fate.
You! You shouldn't exist... A mistake that ruined the whole plan...
Please save my daughter. And I'll spare nothing to reward you.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Let us turn to the Light and reject dark thoughts... The Light leads us forward...

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: When reason capitulates before a new danger, we can do nothing but believe.
May the Light bless you and help you dispel the Darkness that has enveloped our world.
Welcome to Jigran! To the last Stronghold of Light in this unfortunate world that has been swallowed by darkness!

Text.en: What if it's this force? I think we'll find out soon.
We should be careful, as this thunderstorm could be extremely dangerous.

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: Oh, you should take a closer look, you don't understand how much beauty nature has to offer! Put a lightning rod here!
We have too many scarecrows. Oh, people! But I'm not afraid... Put it here!

@796.en: Stick it in here! Otherwise it will hit the apple tree and we won't have any apples.

@972.en: And I love apple pie so much... Well, loved it.

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: Everyone here knows me, no one can say anything bad about me - I'm doing this for them!
It will be good for everyone if we place them here!
The job is done! Now if it hits the rod, the current will flow to ground!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Katerina: If I don't want to live here, then I won't! I'll do what I want!

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: Katerina: What dreams I had, what dreams! As if I were flying through the air!

@28.en: Katerina: I have already ruined my soul... I don't care whether I go home or to the grave!

@420.en: Go! And remember - the defense must fall! This annoying cabal of bigots and fanatics is a pain in my ass.

customData/elements/Item/elements/Item/t.en: It's not easy to rule a world. War was easier.
They're waiting until I make a mistake to take this world away from me... But I'm stronger than they are!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The lady had a diary. We can learn what happened here.

@20.en: Catch the floating bubbles to get another one!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Interesting story. A childhood friend came back to discover he had been forgotten.
Oh, we are looking at a love triangle. She was sweet on her father's servant, but an unexpected guest ruined all plans.

@20.en: You have caught an Inflatable Bubble!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The story is clear. And our hero is decried as mad. He left the house but didn't get far.
The wretched times! I don't know where to begin! People grow wise before their years. Knowledge is the plague of life.
Of all the woes may Gods deliver us from both - from their love and their wrath.

@20.en: The bubble has burst! Catch the floating bubbles to get another one!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: My talent is simple - moderation and punctuality. I depend on others and I serve you.
The lord is angry, so everyone left, and the whole house is in disarray. Who is to blame? Petrusha, of course
Enough of this. This is a different matter.
I cannot bear the pains I feel. I'm suffering a million torments. The liar laughed at me! People like Molchalin have it all! Bring the coach!
You shouldn't leave while his fate is being decided. Let's wait for the outcome.
We have a secret society and secret meetings... We make waves, brother!
Oh, my bad. I am pathetic and foolish, but I'm ready to fulfill my promise. Everyone has been notified...
We can see signs of conspiracy. And our guest is planning something, since she's gathering all the scoundrels.
I'm an honest officer! There are many ways to earn a rank. There are vacancies, I just want to be a general...
We are too far away, we won't hear anything those birds are saying.
Be careful! We don't want to scare the birds away.
Yep. There are 2 more rubles hidden under the upholstery... I'll get them now!
If they don't let me see Shuponu like right now, I'm not going to hold back!
Get him! Get this big-eared crittter! He's got us all fed up here... Too many mutant cyborgs around!
Yes, and I am in need of additional personnel, by the way. The "New Reality" project is not a reason to forget about space!
Grand horizons and magnificient achievements of science lay ahead! Let us make that which we could only dream of a reality!
Sven was the first one to go to the Astral, and we'll be the first in space! Gib-Gib-Gibberlings! Off we go!!!
A resounding success! This is the first step to new accomplishments! I hope we'll have another chance to work together!
We must be cautious – the government will do anything to conceal the truth!
It's not easy at all to get into that zone – the information is throroughly classified. But from there, doors can be opened.
The very heart of the zone, where our government is hiding the truth about the aliens from the people!
Here it is! I knew it! They really do exist! That's an alien! A Horned Three-Eyed Brain Eater! Now we need for everyone to learn the truth!
Looks like we're already close to the exit! Remember, they would do anything to stop us!
Have we really got out? Before today, I was thwarted every time... But now, luck is on our side! We need to find my shelter now...
That's it – we're out of their reach, they won't be able to stop us here... We need to tell the entire world about the alien!
Time to unveil the truth and rip away the shroud of lies that our government has been spreading, for years now, through the media! We need to tell everyone what is real!
Everything is all right. You need to adhere to the plan. Follow the instructions. Adhere to the plan.
The less everyone knows of whatever is really happening, the better. Look at what you've done!
Wherein lies the truth, my friends? Speaking the truth should be a pleasant thing to do... Are you ready to listen?
"Rutess for every cheni" is an interesting idea, but it still sounds trashy! Come on now, my kinspeople are waiting...
Are the heretics here again? We need to fetch as much explosives as we can! I love to see them blown to bits!
What? Have Bathory's servants infiltrated the Khadmons' Tomb? How insidious... Too bad my traps aren't quite ready!
Has Shereda come back home? What a sweety, my daughter. When she was a child, she would often run away and hide among the tombs...
Looks like it's connected to the tombs of the Khadmons now... We need to find a way to get to the lowest level...
The Despot was interred in the burial chamber on the third, the lowest level of tombs.
I'm not causing any mischief, just repairing the stove − and I feel obliged to remind you the cats are ancient, inviolate animals.
Why are you looking at me like that? We cats have our own ways... Just as Nihaz used to say: "No cat, no life!"
What'd you do with all of them... Oh well: ashes to ashes, dust to dust. As for that writer...
Nihaz had his own plans for him. Take his girlfriend, let's meet at the Library.

Bastards! How dare you disfigure my perfection! Help me, my servants!
Pathetic freaks! To me, your blood isn't good enough to wash my feet with! Kill them, my subjects!
My victims must thank me. Their beauty will be perpetuated in my perfection! My faithful, let's be finished with them!
My Lord! Arise! Your love was calling to me through the ages!
Help! Save me! Without arms I'm... disarmed! I can't even crawl!
