customData/elements/Item/text.en: I will beat you... you two... Hey, three on to one is not fair!
Oh my love, I'd leave the world behind me, just to have you by my side! Your guardian will help us flee unnoticed...
You're all I see in daydreams and at night... You are my air, my love, my angel! I'd rather take the poison than deny you!
Ah, my loyal servant, it's time for us to part! Deliver us from endless painful torture... Pour poison in our wretched cups! Our death will be our fortune!
My life is endless mockery, my doom is preordained... My parents make me give my hand to a cripple and a faint!
The evil world of tyrants, of evil, and of taint... The poison only will relief and free us from our fate!

@20.en: I will show you a Trinity Church, you son of a dog! I will give you some God's grace!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: What are you doing?! Get out of my sight, you milksops!

You prrobably were told those scary tales about hungurrs when you were little? About our unrighteous kinsmen whose tya was rejected by Yao Realm, zoor?

They exist for real, and we, doolgas, defend our people from their spite and hatred!

The Crystal Stream... It was called so because its water is as clear as fine crystal!

There is plenty of fish and bears who catch it around. Pay no mind to them.
Wisdom and caution... Grreat! Now what will Tooraah say!
Keen mind and craftsman skillfulness... This will be a tough choice, eysh! Two of the Primals have already marked you!
Strength and power... This is a rare combination. Ekhe doesn't usually send his sign to young Pridens...
Cunning and guile! All four Prrimals have responded to your appeal. Unbeliev... Who dares to interrupt the Council?!

@20.en: Snow caps on the mountain tops, hoar-frost on the windows, snowstorms and frosts... Feel the cold!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Don't yield to it, kylys! You are the Enlightened, you cannot die. Think of life that fills the world! Life that the ancestors have bestowed upon you!
The big world is full of dangers, and you will need many friends that you can rely on. You will find them either in the Empire or the League!
You were marked by fate, and none of us knows what is waiting for you.
You will always strive toward the horizon, eysh! All the roads are open to you...
But there is something that we know for sure: your road will lead you to the Holy Land.
Any Branch would be happy to accept you. We were arguing for a long time, and we understood what was the most important...
We are happy to welcome you at the Council, kylys! The Golases thank you for your help.

Choose wisely, kinsman. Swear allegiance to either the Empire or the League, join their ranks, and set out to the Holy Land!
Our enemies are hiding there. The enemies of all living things!
Find them! Follow your path till the very end, Priden!
You can't even imagine how sick and tired I am of snacking on rats and drinking stale water in this Refuge! While sleeping on rags in a damp cave!
Don't you know that illusory barbecue tastes just as good as the real thing? Just like any other food and drink? At times, it's even tastier!
We're doomed anyway - with Tep, resistance is futile. Sihal promised to grant me power in the Illusion in exchange for info on the Refuge. I'm not going surrender to you. Catch ya later!
What is carrion doing in my house? Not carrion yet? That can be helped... Servants! Kill them all! Although... Leave one of them alive, I haven't finished yet.
Weak... I hate the weak! Why do graveworms like you exist in the first place? So unnatural! And I'll correct that!

Do you know why I let you live? Because I need someone to warn the other slugs hiding out in holes. Scum like you can't hear the music of the universe, can't understand the magnificence of its intent... Yet I hear it all the time!
Get lost, you piece of crap! Hurry up to save your worthless life! Soon I'll make this world the way it was meant to be... the way I saw it in my dreams...

Text.en: I'll ask Master to allow me to suck your Spark myself!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Sarang Naroo: Where am I? What are those strange mechanisms? Where's our fleet?
Renat Idein: Oh Nezeb, what's going on here?! Take me to the headquarters, quickly!
Laurentine de Desirae: Am I dreaming? Or not? Oh what a nightmare...
Fury... Crazystorm's daughter, if you know him... It's thanks to her that Kurgan has the Merciless clan on his side now.

@20.en: Alas, Orcs don't really respect age and experience. They think Crazystorm is too old, and Fury has charisma!
And Kurgan himself decided to become a prophet: he says the June portal on Suslanger will bring the new Legendary Orc here!
Now you understand why the Orcs greeted you like that? They have been sitting in the desert for months, waiting.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I hope we'll reach our destination without incidents this time...
I kno... believe that the Orcs have a part to play in this story. So have patience: you saved Fury, and she won't forget that.
Yes, that's the square... The embodiment of mortals' ambitions. They wanted to conquer the desert!
Let's see if you can find your way around the city. The garden we need is behind the Tower in the square across the bridge from us.
You're finally here! I was starting to worry... Come here, let's talk.
Greetings, my friends! May your days be long, your purse full, and your camel fed.
Like the grandfather of my grandfather used to say, the desert is treacherous... One moment the bright sun shines in the sky, then suddenly a fierce wind rises up, tearing the skin off your bones...
But the desert is also generous! Its riches are boundless, you only need to know how to find them... Wise elders know how to find water there...
...but water is not the only treasure... I know ancient artifacts are hidden in the desert. Artifacts created by Great Nezeb, praise his name!
And the luckiest ones will find these treasures! But you must be careful, because the desert guards its secrets!
I'll tell you about ancient legends... About something that none of the living has seen for a long time. It is true that the Brotherhood of the Last Shelter once existed on Suslanger.
And it was founded by those who did not tolerate the whip, did not want to break their backs at the plantations, who dreamed of being free in every sense of the word!
The Brotherhood was founded by runaway slaves and exiles. They lived in caves, as there are dozens of them in the area.
They knew how to get away from the guards quietly so no one noticed. And it's not the only thing the Brotherhood was famous for. They kept countless treasures stolen from Nezeb.
Oh, kind people! Spare a coin for the poor orphan! Luck will be on your side!
If you want stories, I'll tell you... I know a lot but I can only share this one with you.
There's a place called the Court of Miracles. It's called that way for a reason: the place is indeed full of miracles. A lame person will start walking normally there, ha ha!
But it's not the only miracle. The Gray Prince rules the place, the most cunning man in the whole of Sarnaut. There's no one wealthier than the Prince in the world!
There are caves filled with treasures at the Court of Miracles... And the piles keep growing! That's the story... Spare a coin for the poor orphan!

Let's see what we have here... I think I heard noises coming from somewhere ahead. Let's be on our guard.

There should be a hidden entrance here...

There... Look... There's a large entrance ahead! Maybe it's what we're looking for...

But a jinn is guarding it...
Let's see... Maybe there's some hidden switch there...
There's some passage behind the rocks... Maybe if we get closer...
Well... There's something over there... Maybe I could squeeze through.

@28.en: Fury the Merciless: We are here to meet the Legendary Orc who has been reborn!
Fury the Merciless: Our wise shaman realized that these aliens are part of the prophecy!
Fury the Merciless: With her magic, this redhead... I mean the mighty Eladia...
Landfill Warrior: The world will fall at our feet! The Orcs will rule the world!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: This orc dame is cute! I love them. The bigger the ass, the better!
Well, it's so boring on Nea... I had to amuse myself by pestering Eurial...
There's a pioneer camp here? I haven't been, and they wouldn't let me join... Because I was a hooligan with bad marks!

@28.en: Exodus of Jinns

customData/elements/Item/text.en: They say Trunk himself spent a vacation here, is that right? I once wrote him a letter... Like, where is the new stuff? We are not getting anything!
They say it's a mess on Izune right now! I mean, it was bad before! But now it's worse!
They say you're friends with this Erfar... You shouldn't trust him. Zayan told me a lot about him...
The local Orcs say there is some kind of Uro-Boros that eats everything it hears!
Say I become a chief. What's next? I go to Yasker and say "let my people go"?
Oh Tep, I saw these Ifrits... in a dream! In the cave that elf took me to!
Oh... I just ran away and took the storm with me... Well, now I can lie down...
Ah, refreshing! Waste no time, run between the bones, draw this worm here...

@20.en: I wonder how the Ambrosia will affect the fighting abilities of the local creatures!
We should be careful when we interact with the surrounding reality.
Don't hurry me! The investigation... continues!
Do we really need this project? I think we have many interesting things in Sarnaut...
Me and my two rapid-fire crossbows are the best team!
I prefer battles in the catacombs where you can always bring something down on the enemy. Or throw them down!
They call me a grave robber, but really, do the inhabitants of these graves need treasures?
I hope someday my accomplishments will be recognized by the scientific community!
Suslanger is the perfect place to hide something, but honestly, I'm already sick of the sand! I'm going to the glacier!
The creatures here are so hideous... And those Ifrits are the worst... It's both tempting and dangerous!
My agents report that Ambrosia prices are on the rise!
The higher the risk, the greater the profit. Just don't lose your head chasing it!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Kurgan the Crafty: He is Skulnar the Fierce, the reborn Legendary Orc and our leader! Chief, a speech for your people!

@28.en: Fury the Fierce: ...And the Hero of Sarnaut is a new friend of our people!

customData/elements/Item/subtitles/Item/.en: Landfill Warriors: Eh... and the Hero of Sarnaut! Freedom and strength!
Landfill Warriors: Freedom and strength! Freedom and strength! Freedom and strength!

@20.en: And if that wasn't enough, the Unyielding family, our brothers, got tired of waiting for the Legendary Orc. They have gone off their rocker when Fury let you go.
Someone also stole some water and a bunch of parts during your escape... I don't know what to do, I hope you and Fury will come up with something.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: And I'll probably leave my post anyway, just don’t tell anyone. For years, I've had no idea what life is like outside the Landfill...

@20.en: The Hero of Sarnaut can't even handle a small task like this? We should return to this orc!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: If we leave Fury now, it will end badly...

@20.en: Worms are the last thing we need right now!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Phew... That was close. We just need to think of a way to stop somewhere...
Great, just straight ahead now! There's a ship's frame ahead, ride to its very top!
Well, I have everything I need now! You don't need me here anymore... I'll see you back at the car.
Hmm... Stories of ancient artifacts... I've dreamt of finding them ever since I was young...

@20.en: Why me? I scout out the area, I get the water - should I clean out the latrines, too?
Can't even tell where I should whack it! On the head? Or the tail? Where is the head, anyway?!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Come on! For mommy! For brothers!

@20.en: If an Orc lived to twenty five, he's not an Orc but a piece of shit! We die young!
Yes, Ambrosia is a very curious phenomenon... It appeared in this Desert quite recently...
I'd like to see how it influences other creatures in this desert...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We'll have something to discuss with the guys at the biological station! Perhaps we'll even get the Imperial award!

@20.en: They are completely crushed... It's going to devour them all at this rate!
Quiet! Did you hear that? The Legendary Orc is awake! He will talk to us!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Orcs! We are the masters of our destiny!
Oh, you're getting up? I haven't even made breakfast yet... Come, let's talk.
Let's get this guard that's standing right above me. Surprise him!

@28.en: Scorpion

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There are many things hidden in the desert! Humans hid treasures in the sands, hah!
They went to the desert, found the Landfill, and it became their home.
If an Orc lived to twenty five, he's not an Orc but a piece of shit!
The Great Feast is starting soon! The Orcs will rule the world once again!

@20.en: Don't kill me! People living a good life don't become thieves, but I swear I'll turn my life around!
Please, don't do it! I'd rather start a new life from scratch than die!
You can't jump up unless you drop down! Fall on your back! Come on, be brave. And one... and two... and three... And done.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: A vestibular system training. Spin! Spin! Spin! And one... and two... and three... And done.

@20.en: Hop! Hop as high as you only can! Knees up! And one... and two... and three... And done.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We still can't find her, Olga! But don't mark her as absent! I'm sure she'll be back in no time.

@20.en: What sits at the bottom of the sea and twitches? A nervous wreck.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Knock-knock! - Who's there? An Astral Academy student! What are you doing in the Igsh Military District? - I failed my mid-term exams...

@20.en: I saw a guy spill all his Astrabble tiles on the road. I asked him, "What's the word on the street?"

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Why doesn't Nihaz have any friends?

@20.en: Why did the chicken cross the street? To get to the other side!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Because he's a real pain in the dark!

@20.en: What do we want? - Low-flying astral ship noises! When do we want them? - Nnneeeeeooooooow!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Catherina accused Zayan of being too immature...

@20.en: Attention, pioneers! A roll call. Answer "ME!" whenever you hear your name.
Louis de Gris!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Everyone's present. Great. Troop number two! Samantha de Delice!

@20.en: What is that? Looks like a recorded broadcast. I need to ask the orc announcer.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It's too early to attach the sphere. You need to install the camera first.

@20.en: Alright. Back soon. I'll just soak up some rays, and come back.
When I was a kid, I used to go to pioneer camps, too. We had a very hard time sleeping in makeshift tents, cooking on campfires, and bringing water in buckets. Our life wasn't very well organized.
Now look around! Look at the cabins we have built! The lawns we have laid! The water supply! Manavision! The cafeteria! Flower beds! Greenhouses! Events!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There's only so much one can do on their own, but there's so much we can achieve together! If you think that you can do on your own, you're mistaken. If you think others can't do without you, you're mistaken even more.

@20.en:
This is exactly why we gathered here, in the camp. I want you to remember this year. It's full of hardships and struggles that bring us closer together.

Now let's watch the motion story.
The motion story it over, . Find Alice. She's gone. She might be at the beach.
Rest, grow stronger, grow smarter! We're doing everything for you! You're the masters of the camp. What is required of you? Only discipline.
Sadly, it's not your forte. But we're working on it. We also want to find new talents. At least one per unit.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Together we can do what one man can't do. United minds and hands, their concentrated abilities can be nearly the most powerful force.

@20.en: Teamwork is the best. The team is always right. A team is always better than a solo individual. Smarter, braver, more honest.
Xadaganians once believed in development and progress. Guided by the great Nezeb, they set on the path to progress. Then the orcs joined them. Then the Arisen.
Now there are even more of us. Sarnaut is embraced by the greater friendship. We're pacing toward the great future together.
Getting together is the beginning. Keeping together is the progress. Working together is the success. There's happiness in unity. Happiness unites.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ugh, no, I can't go on like this. Silence! Silence in the audience! Man, I have to start over.
You simply don't understand me... or you don't trust me. Ah, whatever.

@20.en: Oh, wow, we're beyond the buoys! We're on our own in the middle of the lake. What a funny situation, isn't it?
And we're at the same time pioneers and NOT pioneers. Two places, two statuses. Do you understand?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It's only valid until someone finds us or sees us. And it will define where we are and who we are. The magic will crumble down.

@20.en: What's going to happen to the in-the-camp us? The not-pioneers us? They're just as real, only much more fragile.

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Sometimes it's enough to look at something, learn, or touch something to destroy it. A lot of if's make up one definite "is."

Do you ever regret the lost if's?

@20.en: One needs to understand when and how fire can be used. Fire is an untamed element. The larger it is, the bigger the temptation. And the threat.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: That's better. I can get warm now. The fire is ambiguous, you know. It can be good in a stove or ovens, or to warm up us, pioneers.

@20.en: It can be dangerous. I'm talking about wildfires, inferno. Even mages' fiery arrows can deal a lot of damage.
The good it brings is also undeniable. Science and magic tech are striving. Even Landfill orcs have manamobiles.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ambrosia is much like fire in this regard. Catherina has been seduced. Not just her. I've seen you pick up the crystals.

@20.en: I believe that ambrosia is raw power. Part of what is called Life. Life always finds a way. You can't break it. It heals all wounds. Even the wounds of Sarnaut.
I'm a little cold. Look, someone lit a campfire over there. Let's get closer to warm up a little.
That's true. We're prisoners in our world, but we can cheat our guard.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I wasn't going to.

@20.en: Not every power can be defeated or tamed. Think what it'll take to tame it.
I'm not sad, just thoughtful. Everything has become illusionary. I don't know if I exist, in the first place.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There's a lot I cannot tell. It's not because I don't want to. I simply can't.

@20.en: Too perfect, in fact. Life is the greatest power of the Universe.
I can't tell you everything! Why don't you understand?! I just CAN'T!
The words you're saying are wise. You know what I mean. You should watch out.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You've made a cage of your lies.

@20.en: Poor fellow. Your fate has long been sealed, even before you set foot on this path.
Same for me, believe me. I made a mistake. I needed to fix it. I understand. More than anyone!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: If there's someone you can trust, you won't feel lonely even in a prison.

@20.en: That is true. Their aspiration may lead to bad consequences.
You can trust me. I had to lie but for a good cause.
You're right, but you have to look further and beyond.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: This is the eternal cycle. Believe me, there are someone who wants to break it.

@20.en: You've had a hard time. Too much for you. I wish I could help you carry your weight.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Our world is a bet in a bigger game.

@20.en: What a nice boulder! It must be so cozy to watch the sunset from. Help me get up.
It's so nice to see the setting sun, isn't it? It's a shame that it's just an illusion.
Yes, it is. There's no flaming sphere, spinning 'round Sarnaut. Each allod has its own independent sun position.
It's part of the Great Mage's spell to restrain the astral absorption. That's why you can't see it from the shore, where the spell is weakest.
Makes you wonder if other obvious things are what they seem to be. What deeds lead you to the opposite of your expectations.
There's the flip side. The sun isn't real, but what does that change? Not every illusion is bad. Has anyone benefited from realizing that it's an illusion?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Look! Boats! Let's steal one and go for a ride! Row! Row!

@20.en: Clams are funny. They're so eternally attached to their little world, they have no idea about the big the world that is around them.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: But even if they did, they would never leave their little shell. It's their integral part. Their stronghold, their prison.

@20.en: When something gets into it from the big world, a grain of sand or a pebble, the clam would wrap it in pearl. Thus creating a smaller prison inside a bigger prison. Are we accustomed to our own prisons?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We're tired from puzzles! Can't things be plain and simple?

@20.en: Don't be sad, Alice. I know you exist. You're real.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Catherina and the Empire depend on this power. They will do anything.

@20.en: I like to think that Sarnaut will be cured. That we'll fight the temptation.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Living in prison is only worth it if there's a pearl.

@20.en: We build our own prison.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I discovered a lot of mysteries. I've been chasing them around Sarnaut for years.

@20.en: One thing I learned in my travels is that new knowledge provokes new anxieties. I want a break from mysteries.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I don't really understand whom to trust. There are way too many mysteries.

@20.en: The truth is that we're only two pioneers, skipping a festival in the middle of a lake.
Every force causes a reaction. Chaos is replaced by Order. Death retreats in the face of Life.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: There have been too many people craving for our pearls lately.

@20.en: You are leaving the Storm. Come back to continue searching for Ifrits' treasures.

customData/text.en: Uro-Boros is currently out of reach.

@20.en: Buzz the Boffin: Stop loitering, do something useful!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: May there always be sunshine, may there always be blue skies, may there always be summer, may there always be food!

@20.en: Keep flying... from the west to the east...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Two steps to the West, ten steps to the North... So, where is the hidden treasure?

@20.en: Buzz the Boffin: Two steps to the West, ten steps to the North... So, where is the hidden treasure?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hey you! Yes, you! Take me down from here!

@20.en: Buzz the Boffin: Freeee as a bird...
May there always be sunshine, may there always be blue skies, may there always be summer, may there always be food!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Congratulations, you are flyer number 1000! There's a gift for you... Where are you going?! Why are you all leaving?!
All bubbles have burst! Let's wait a little, the wind will bring new bubbles soon.
The crab race will start in a minute, hurry up and make a Random bet!

@20.en: July is over. Now you'll have to wait a year until the next bonfire season.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Dancing is over! Let us offer our thanks to the sun!

@20.en: The bird is confused

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Oh! One of them became your companion! That's great, my friend.
A funny ball of feathers. Just don't let it get underfoot...

@20.en: The volleyball is temporarily closed! I'll rake the sand and clean the ball - then we'll be open again.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The volleyball court is open!

Text.en: How could I forget you possess this power already. I’ll have to kill you myself then.
A living incarnation, it’s unbelievable. Use the ring, quick!
Enough. I’ve got more important things to do. Eclipse is ready to sail off. And I’m taking my gift with me. Farewell!
What can you do to me, the great Queen?
Whoever you are, be informed, that the Mystery Seal cannot be restored. Go away.
Too late. The Veil of Mystery sealed Umoir once again. What have you done.
Reveal yourself, Leper! Accept my body and my soul! Grant me your power!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ugh... Damn you... Oh very well, hero, go, take a look at your beloved!
How dare you! Oh you just hold on now!
Are you one of the knights that my Annette mentioned? Where is she? Is she alive?

@20.en: Are you one of the knights that my Annette mentioned? Where is she? Is she alive?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: What happened here? Where’s Annette?
You are too late. Or, then again, may be not. Come up, I’ll tell you everything.
Free at last! Now you’re going to die!
Such a shame, it hasn’t been too long since his wife died, and he already springs to a new marriage. What’s more, a marriage to a human! So, what is it this time?

@20.en: Such a shame, it hasn’t been too long since his wife died, and he already springs to a new marriage. What’s more, a marriage to a human! So, what is it this time?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It’s a mirror! I haven’t seen it myself, but they say it’s a beauty, all silver and gold, and precious gems along the rim!
She’s such a trap! Mind my words, she’s going to ruin our whole House, she will!
Just you come up, I’ll pluck out your beard!.. Oh, you’re not one of Jeer’s servants. Let me out! I’ll pay you good!
I’ve seen deeper gaps. Hop on my back, I’ll carry you over.

customData/elements/Item/action/text.en: Damn, it’s a trap! Cover me, I’ll break the door.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Move on to the future! I mean, Time Machine is in the hangar on the hill.
I’ll take the Grain and will risk my life by suppressing the elementals. Your task is to beat them.
It’s so deep here! Don’t be scared, I’m with you. Take my jumping boots and jump over!
Look, magical locks! They must have been just invented, so easy to open! I only wonder, in which order...
That wizard is summoning the elementals! Do something!
I’m way too tired, I think, it’s enough.
There, portal closed, time and space secured. This is a real scientific glory!
I remeber you well now! Beware!
Whew, the way is free! Hold on now, you underground whisperer!

@20.en: Nickel: I can hear something! Or is it you?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Here’s where it’s coming from! Now we need to dig that out at any price!

@20.en: Nickel: Here’s where it’s coming from! Now we need to dig that out at any price!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: This whisper will drive me mad...
Is it a dead end? Oh no! See this light? It’s the evil spirit.

We’re not magically educated, but we know a thing or two! The best method against the evil spirit is a trigem amulet. We need an amethyst, and an agate, and a malachite. I’m sure we can easily find them.

@20.en: Nickel: Something flashed! Ah, no, simple quartz.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hang on... I can hear whispers... We are not alone.
So many monsters! They’re so strong, they don’t even have to hide. We cannot pass before we defeat them.
Whoever is not greedy about someone else’s riches, may be safely trusted with the Prophetic Ruby! You will not use it for evil.
As to you, impostor... I have a reward for you, too.
I’m rich, I’m rich! I can buy whole Kania and half Umoir now!
Don’t kill me! I didn’t take a thing! Here, take it all back.

Text.en: Was it the Light that helped Tekyan survive without home or protection, when the June were gone? Was it the Light that taught them to build houses and grow fruit trees? Was it the Light that saved them from the Crystal Mountain?
Wait a minute! I’m a representative of the Church of the Light, and I’m not going to cooperate with some pagan idol!
That’s what I’m talking about. Any sapent being must be given opportunity to enlighten their souls with the Light! While you, so-called god, are obscuring their vision!
You stupid lizard, I’m not listening to this damned crocodile! I will inform Catherina that you are a part of it all!
Lie! You are pagans! If you really believe in the Light, prove it! Come through death, and return alive!
What’s that nonsense? Since when does the Light require the sacrifices of innocent creatures?
You are blind! You cannot even see the Light! And you dare teaching others! Lay down arms, I will show you the Light!
This is what you truly are! Only lies and blasphemy! You will pay for it! Light or condemn!

@28.en: This is the Tensess’ servant! Why is he attacking us?

@20.en: His defenses weaken! Recharge the trinket now! Hurry!

@28.en: This portal led to Umoir long ago. We used to do some illegal trade, have our share, you know, before the Queen found out. She locked the portal then, and however hard we tried to open it, we failed. Your friend must be pretty powerful - she clicked her fingers and passed, that’s that. So she’s nowhere else, but in Umoir now. Want to catch up with her? Touch the four June pillars here and go, don’t let the door hit your... rear.

Text.en: Why don't you go back to your wild forest? You stink.
Why don't you go back to your wild forest? You stink.
You're hiding behind a woman! Your heads are going to fall.

@28.en: You're hiding behind a woman! Your heads are going to fall.

Text.en: We don't need your pagan help! We can stand up for our land ourselves!

@28.en: We don't need your pagan help! We can stand up for our land ourselves!

Text.en: How the hell is it yours? You must have forgotten your own history!
The Light is sacred, our faith is firm! We don't need you petty gods.

@28.en: The Light is sacred, our faith is firm! We don't need you petty gods.

@20.en: So where's your Queen? Where's your irreplaceable lady?

@28.en: So where's your Queen? Where's your irreplaceable lady?

@20.en: How dare you, scum! I will rip your guts out!
Halt!

Text.en: Pray to your Light to die fast, Upper City thugs!

@20.en: People of Umoir! Can you not hear the earth trembling and moaning under the heavy step of the Leper and its awful creatures? They are your enemies number one! Forget Catherina and her guards! We are all in one boat now. The undead of the Ancient Mound is out to destroy and wipe out life at the allod! We must fight the Leper, before it is too late!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Umoir is going through hard times... Can you not see this? You sworn to the Queen to guard and protect these lands from all enemies! It is time to fulfill your vow! Forget the Outcasts! We are all in one boat now. The undead of the Ancient Mound is out to destroy and wipe out life at the allod! We must fight the Leper, before it is too late!

People of Umoir! Can you not hear the earth trembling and moaning under the heavy step of the Leper and its awful creatures? They are your enemies number one! Forget Catherina and her guards! We are all in one boat now. The undead of the Ancient Mound is out to destroy and wipe out life at the allod! We must fight the Leper, before it is too late!

Text.en: How... how can it be? How can the dead return?.. But it is true! There goes my grandpa...

@20.en: It all came true... Exactly like the prophets said... Forgive us, grandfathers! What shall we do now? Fight together?
Everything seems to be really bad, if the dead raised from their graves... So be it! Let us fight the undead together!

Text.en: Now you are talking. Don't you dare forget about your blood relations any more. Brother must not fight brother. We have a different enemy!

@20.en: Here's how our descendants treat the memory of us... Not united any longer, they only fight and quarrel. It must be the Leper in their hearts. Shame, such a shame...

@28.en: It was a good battle. Meet me at the exit from the Mound, we need to talk.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Ha! The fort defenders forgot to remove the ladder. Climb it, now!

@20.en: What? I have no idea what you are talking about!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: ...How dare you?! The Order will put an end to this war!

Text.en:
Enemies approach!

A giant monster is among them!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Idiot! I told you to get rid of that Alliance snooper without a fuss! And what have you done?!

I hope you at least where smart enough to tie up loose ends!
You dumb head, do you have any idea what the Sculptor will do to us if we screw up?

@20.en: You dumb head, do you have any idea what the Sculptor will do to us if we screw up?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Everything's going according to plan. There's just one problem - Whip failed to keep it low profile. My guess is that Whip is done...
You fool! That's the Alliance spy! Get him and meet me in the castle!

@20.en: You fool! That's the Alliance spy! Get him and meet me in the castle!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hey boss! Somebody's hiding behind the lorry!

What's up, commander?

If something's wrong, we have nothing to do with that.
Nothing personal, babe, it's just my job. Don't mess with respected people!

@20.en:
Hey boss, I'm here again!

Why are you looking at me so angrily? What is this shovel for?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: What happened to me? My head is splitting!

@20.en: Hm... If what you are telling is true, then it really turns the situation around...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I think I have to agree with that. When guns are speaking, diplomats choose to remain silent.

@20.en: And how did you escape the Architects and get here?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: What? Guards! Who is that man and what is he doing here?

@20.en: What? Guards! Who is that man and what is he doing here?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Listen to me! I don't know how it happened, but the monsters have sealed Dane off the rest of the world. Completely! The Portals and charms of mental communication just won't work. Unless we send for help right now, we are dead...

@20.en: Listen to me! I don't know how it happened, but the monsters have sealed Dane off the rest of the world. Completely! The Portals and charms of mental communication just won't work. Unless we send for help right now, we are dead...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Dane was attacked by an army of nameless monsters! They are everywhere! They've got fortifications in the ruins, and the capital's on fire! I watched them sink the last ship that protected the Shore City...

@20.en: Dane was attacked by an army of nameless monsters! They are everywhere! They've got fortifications in the ruins, and the capital's on fire! I watched them sink the last ship that protected the Shore City...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I swear on the Light, I was lucky! I hid my boat, "Bleak Pony", in a harbor at some distance from the Shore City. When the monsters attacked our defenses, I sneaked to my ship and took off to the nearest Astral wormhole. I survived by a miracle!
And how did you escape the Architects and get here?
The dead man is wearing a shabby Alliance jaegers' uniform. Why would a jaeger come to the city?..
There's a prisoner's tattoo on the dead man's shoulder. They could have hardly recruited an ex-con as a jaeger...

@20.en: There's a prisoner's tattoo on the dead man's shoulder. They could have hardly recruited an ex-con as a jaeger...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Did you see those Initiates run? They even left their cart behind, haha!
Come on, now it's your turn!
Let's show the enemy what war means!
Ay-hya! I know how to use these. Give them to me, eysh!
Shoysh, we're out of bombshells... Bring some more, now!
We're out of shelves, but I can offer a Xadaganian bed with a night table.

@20.en: It must have gone blunt. Sharpen it and try again.
It looks like the cutter got blunt. Sharpen it.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The second was Rita Osanina. Her son is now an orphan...

@20.en: The first one's name was Yela Komelkova. Such a beautiful girl...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Sonya Gurvichskaya died the last. She was saving my life...

@20.en: It looks pretty sharp to me!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Galia Chetvertakova was the fourth. Her death was horrifying...

@20.en: What are you doing? You have erased one name. Now you have to start it all over.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Careful! Don't rub too hard.

@20.en: What is wrong with you? It's all crooked. You have to rewrite this!

customData/elements/Item/text.en:
Hey boss, I'm here again!

Why are you looking at me so angrily? What is this shovel for?

Text.en: That's right, the freaks gotta know their place!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Right... But they took the girl anyway. Why would they need her?
You stupid cow! Do you realize what they are going to do with us if we screw up? The Sculptor will be furious! We are the new prisoners? Where are they?!

@1452.en: That's none of your business, you dumb-horned. Her Spark is vital for the future Ascen... Ahem, we have guests!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Shut up, you idiot. That's not us, that's you! You caused all the mess in the Iron City! And why would you bring a technomancer girl to the castle?

@20.en: We have to be ready when it happens. But before that - you’re right, we just have to watch the sky.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: If each one of you is ready for the hardest deed in your life, if each of you has something to offer in the upcoming war, the Empire is on your side.
I don’t deny the necessity of peace. I just don’t feel very comfortable with the parties of this alliance.
Words, words... Stirring words have never saved anyone from crisis - you can trust me on that.
So be it. It's time to lift up our eyes to the sky and wait for the new war.
But the most important question is... When will the Dark God come?
Expect him every day, every second. When you close your eyes at night, think how you can beat him. Wake up thinking of him.
I’m glad you could find the time to meet us here...

@20.en: I’m sorry for what we had to do to attract your attention.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: The matter we have to discuss can no longer be delayed.
You’re all saying that the Dark God is returning.
Neither the League nor the Empire can stand through another war after the Architects...
He can’t be coming here just to destroy us all!
We’re not ready for war - especially not with a god, especially not shoulder to shoulder with our old enemy!
You can persuade us as much as you want; it won’t change the fact that we don’t have enough soldiers.
The morale has been low since our terrible losses on Dane...
Our victory over the Architect and Sarn gave life to your race - now you want us to give our own lives!
I hate to agree with this old pacifist, but he’s right. Peace with the League will only do good for both sides.

@20.en: Yes, you are weaker than ever. And in case of conflict with Nihaz - which will be the case! - our losses will be tremendous.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: If you want me to speak your language, let it be so.

@20.en: Don’t make scenes in front of me and each other, trying to prove how weak you are.
Sarnaut is about to enter the time of war - and the time of war law. The strongest will make that law. The weakest will be sacrificed and fed to the enemy like a sick sheep.
I am holding out a helping hand. If you take it, you have a chance to survive. If you don’t... you will be left alone and face to face with darkness.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Never mind the League, but since when did the Empire lose its wits?
As soon as a new enemy shows up, orcs are lining up to be in the vanguard!
If you still didn’t get how bad things are - they pulled ME out of the past in order to get ANYONE to help them in that war.
You keep complaining that your soldiers can’t fight? Maybe they need a new commander?!
I can turn their brains inside out and purge them properly... I don’t care if they are Great Mages, huh.
I’m familiar with the concept of duty, so my Net will help you in the war with the Dark God, if such comes...
I’m sorry - I cannot deliver this news on your emotional level.
The children of Chaos were strong enough to confront our armada. Thanks to your actions, I am whole again and I can continue my self-development.

@20.en: What about you, Historian? You have lived in this world longer than anyone. What does your wisdom of centuries say?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: It’s not a problem, my friend - emotions only obscure our minds.
To live to see the day when history stops repeating itself. When our mind triumphs over our nature - the nature of killers.
I have seen many wars, and I have seem many truces. Our sworn enemies have turned into our best friends before.
Their names now live on in legends, though the memory of them is lost in centuries.
But they walked the same path as their descendants later, and the descendants of their descendants walked the same path as we walk now...
Fratricidal wars, forced peace just to lick your wounds, the joy of common victories... It’s a shame that generations never seem to learn anything.
After all these centuries - even millenniums! - I only wish for one thing...
For thousands of years, we’ve been developing magic and science, passing our knowledge from generation to generation.
I’ll be damned if I let some arrogant god destroy all this!
I don’t care how life came to this world. This is our home, and we make our rules here.
Let Nihaz come. If he wants to do something to this world, he better ask - and VERY politely - in advance.
Everyone has something to lose. A great job has been done on this world!
This winged mare can deliver you to the Coliseum. Be careful, the beast is mean. Don't let her throw you off into the Astral.

Text.en: Welcome, welcome! Our inn ‘Purgatory’ is not opened yet, so I’m sorry for not offering you a cold glass of beer!

@20.en: The cold wind turned into a spring breeze. That was beautiful... but didn’t last long.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I’m blind, but I can see a lot of things. Everyone was running and looking for a shelter. Many joined in the face of danger and tried to fight. It was beautiful... and terrifying.

@20.en: The Well of Souls was destroyed, and the explosion burned out the Astral itself within many miles around it. The Black Void replaced it... That is where everything started!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: But nothing could save us. Aidenus fell. Yasker fell. The Great Mages were dying one after another, and only a small group of their apprentices survived.

@20.en: The Demons tried to hold off the darkness until the very end. But soon they were simply gone..
No more Kanian Archipelagos, no more Igsh, no more Umoir, no more Suslanger... Nothing. Just Darkness.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: You always followed in the wake of death, but now death walks hand in hand with you. Do what you have to... And welcome to the Last Shelter.

@20.en: Now we all live here. All of us - Gibberlings, Orcs, Pridens, Elves, Humans... Somehow we manage. Our supplies are running out. If the Darkness doesn’t devour us, we will soon die of hunger.
Some of us gave their lives to the Tree, to help it hold off the Darkness... For we couldn’t stand by ourselves any longer.
On the bones of our brothers, sisters, and children, the last hope grows... And withers more every day.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I know why you’ve come here, child. I was hoping that you could save us... But I can see too much. Aoidoi called you the Stormbringer for a reason.

Text.en: This is the truth. I’ll need some time to stabilize the portal.

@20.en: Light up the lantern to provoke the energy emanations. Direct them to me.

Text.en: Cut the red cable! Not the blue one! NOT THE BLUE ONE!
This is what you get when you mess with Skulnar and... erm... what was your name again?
I have some special memories about this room... Huh, now you’ll see SOMETHING.
Ghost! It’s a ghost! Haha! And a blue one!
Hey, boss, the demon seems to be anxious. What if it breaks out?..

@20.en: The space has stabilized. Assault Shell and teleportation are available!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Did you come to terms with Klavdia?
A little blood to the testing plate... Now tuning to the life power signature...

@20.en: Well, I see you can drive this thing. The drone has many useful tools equipped.
Secondly, the drone can emit a magical seismic wave to stun and knock back the enemy. It's useful if the drone is surrounded.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Get used to the controls. In the meantime, I'll take the drone to the entrance.
Recording *noise* number three. We are going to the hinterland. We haven't met any resistance so far. That was something we expected. The Catacombs should be abandoned even by local fauna.
*noise* ...the situation went out of control. The expedition officially failed.
Something is hiding in there *noise* ...just as Imperius said... I hope, the Light will help him find it... *noise* ...whatever it is. The expedition journal... *noise* ...ends here. *noise*
There's still something wrong. There were a few accidents *noise* with demons. Elder demons brought to reason lesser demons... blood was spilled. I don't like it.

Recor... *noise* ...seven. We decided to set up a camp. The scientists are not very resilient. Demons... *noise* ...aggressive by the hour. Elder demons find it harder and harder to restrain lesser ones. And they don't seem to be too eager to do so.
Recording... *noise* The demons want a yes or a no. They're not going any further. Either we let them go back upstairs or they... *noise* ...us. *noise* ...casualties on both sides...
*noise* I said "sides", but there no sides in this slaughter. Some of us and some of the dem... *noise* ...lost their minds. It's hard to... think.

*noise* ...ten. They sent the advance party to the lower levels. Only those in their right minds. Very few of them. Imperius and Alastar developed... *noise* ...protect the sanity of others. But for how long?
Recording number... *noise* An explosion on upper levels. Just when we dispatched a party for blood. I hope they're okay.
Record... *noise* The teleportation network is breached. Connection is lost... *noise* ...we don't have much blood to maintain stable condition. Things are bad...
*noise* ...no news from the party. As bad as it may sound, I'm happy they're not here. We... won't last long. Many of us have been... turning into vampires.

@20.en: Alastar, friend! Listen to me! Come back!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: I don't like it. Something inside me responds to the device. Something that must stay silent.
Allow me to recalibrate the portal. Just another safety measure... Done!

@20.en: Together you make any enemy flee! If you make peace, the Claw tribe help you all!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Your spears, your poison, your nets, all useless if you're busy fighting each other!

@20.en: If you want no peace, then we are your enemy. You no stand before the Claw.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Our tribes split up... It was long ago when a crowd of strangers came into our lands.
We found another way. We saw opportunities. Not the whole tribe followed me... But there was enough of us to start a new life.
It's just... Something else came to our land together with the strangers.
Our shamans are howling and crying at night. They see nightmares, but they can't tell what it is. They lose their memory when they wake up.

@20.en: We are sure that the Ancestors are calling for help. What could happen to them? Spirits are free as the Wind...
Return under the shield, or the quest will be failed!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Citovras taught us not to fear the horrors of the night.
But children grow up. It's time for you to make your own path in this world.
The world is cruel. You will face many challenges. Some of you are destined to die.
If your tribe keeps counting on weak spirits, it's bound to fall and perish.
You and your sons must lead the tribe. This is our last will.
The Spiral Ridge Centaurs will come for help at any time.
But... Great spirits! The wisdom of ancestors will go together with you. Who is going to teach the young orcs if not your voice spoken through the shamans?
It is so good to know that orcs have friends beyond Gipat.
We must walk this difficult road by ourselves. If we fail, it means, we aren't worthy of living in this world.
Our time is running out. The word of the dead must fade. The living must live the life.
You can do it, great leader. You don't have the right for defeat.
Victory over darkness deserves respect. But your struggle is only just beginning.
We will leave this world fighting together with you. Very soon. Help for help. This is our gift for you.
These lands are so vast and so beautiful! Is there room for us?
What? Where do you come from? Bridal Bridge, you say? What's with the huge axe you're carrying? Are you mercenaries?
I wish we had enough room for ourselves! The Leper has just begun to retreat. There's nowhere to herd our cattle, nowhere to hunt without risking your limbs to a thousand-toothed rabbit!

@20.en: It's so dark... but I can't feel the presence of evil. It's the natural shadow, cool and inviting.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Hurry, Stormbringer! We've only got till dawn. We must see everything.

@20.en: A big territory and almost no animals. As if an army came and killed them all.
Oh yes, these lands are magnificent. Aren't these people lucky?
Huh, a combat circle? A bit too small for a good fight.
This place remains abandoned...

customData/elements/Item/text.en: No. It's a ritual circle. Spirits used to dwell here, now it's empty.

@20.en: Oh great spirits... is this the Leper that the Headman was talking about?

customData/elements/Item/text.en: All of them are wonderful and big. One of the allods will become our new home!

@20.en: You must be a great warrior!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: If she says the tribe is in danger, it is truly so.
It's a shame Kyros's loss dimmed his mind. Citovras was trying to help, but all he found was death.

@20.en: Of course, our tribe is not as strong without a leader. But Citovras left a great heritage behind. We live up to his teaching and discover the nature of power.
Mountain Wind is leading us now. She is a wise shaman - and my sister.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Be our guest, Stormbringer. The Centaurs respect power.

@20.en: The deep sky. The green fields. The land is beautiful... but too small for the growing nation.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Life is powerful, but small here. We don't have enough food for everyone.

@20.en: ...but we're locked on this allod. We don't know how to see other lands. Help us, please!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: We need a new home, should we want to go on. The wind and the road are calling...
The mirror world, the testimony of the destroyed utopia. Everywhere you look there are copies of copies of copies.
Luck? Providence? Maybe the baby mouse has a place in the great structures of darkness? Listen closely.
Best enemy. Worst friend. It isn't holy. Together with it get, but still you're lonely.
The world is quiet, and a word rings out so loud. The world is dead, but it will throw away death shroud.
Only you know the right way. Don't follow shadows blindly. They will go, and you will stay.
Hello again, Traveler. Are you looking for Darkness in your soul? He, who searches, finds!
Look around. You see familiar faces everywhere. Your friends, your enemies... Which is which, you do not know. What they want, you do not know. Everyone has their goal. Everyone has their method...
They're just a part of the conflict. Unknown variables, each with a role. They are not aware of it, but they're playing it smoothly. Just like me. Just like you.
You see, all of them, and all of us, are shards of Darkness. Darkness is vague. Darkness is future. It has infinite sides. We all are Nihaz.
In the end, don't you think that Sarn managed to create such beautiful living world without help?

A tiny particle of Darkness... Disharmony, conflict, uncertainty... and the world, frozen in the eternal winter and stagnation, comes alive! It's dashing toward its future! You are opposing Darkness, and it is wonderful.

You are pacing forward. You have your free will. Do you think it's illusory?

Any free will is illusory, my friend. Darkness is the essence of natural selection. Today you're on top of it. Tomorrow... who knows?

When you wake up, you will be allowed to look at it from the outside. You will no longer be a part of Darkness. After all, this is what you want. Let's see what will happen to you... And to your world. It will be amusing for everyone to see.

Nihaz has no power over you.
The little guy loved... loves cannons. Looks at that, it’s still intact... and warm. Means it fired.

Demonologists and demons are searching for ways to modernize the Citadel to turn it into a weapon of mass destruction. Everything inside should be burned out, and knowledge accumulated by the so-called “Demonologists” must be destroyed.
Demons and Destroyers led by a demonic sect are ready to set out to travel away from the allod...
...to regroup and attack the capitals of the League and the Empire.
I have a plan for sabotaging the Citadel, and I’ve already started to implement it. I’ll need your help soon. Hurry!

I don’t trust the Demonologists. I’d even say I trust demons more, however strange it may seem... Still, we fought together against the horde of Destroyers. Hell knows what the Demonologists want, but we certainly have a common enemy.
Let’s keep an eye on them for now.
Why would Light Worshippers use that?
Great. I heard you need to blow up some stuff? I can do that...
What, now? What do you mean, “don’t worry”? Or do you gulp down poison every morning?

@20.en: I knew it was that... little bastard!

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Give me a break... I know it was the little bastard’s idea!
Alright... We’ll get to the Citadel and show them all. Just hang on there...

@20.en: Stop quarreling. Sarbaz Sais was behind the sabotage... She went to the Heart of the Citadel.

customData/elements/Item/text.en: Shut your shop. It’s one of ours. They can do way more than your useless owls.
Oh... Cap’n? Wow! What... what’s... I mean... Is that how it’s supposed to... Why are you here?!
So demons mean more to you than our brotherhood? Go join them!
Captain Milas is dead. It’s a great loss for us, especially in a difficult situation like this... But there’s no time to mourn him.
The ship is wrecked, we can’t get off this allod. We have to request help... But the communications are shot.
So we’re stuck here with those horrible creatures? They’ll slaughter us like animals!
Alright... make a scary face and speak louder... Come on, greenhorns, get to work!!

@20.en: Here! Light it!

I swear serve faithful and loyal! For holy Nezeb and Skrakan and Tensess! For Yasker! For Cha Pie-Pie!
Stop! You win, and I recognize your right to speak with me! I will meet you by the menhir.
Allow me. Hm... I can't say for certain quite yet. I'll have to carry out some tests, compare data... I'm sure you understand me, dear colleague?

And if they do allow it, the strength of the Empire will punish them for their deeds! Nezeb and Skrakan are with us! Yasker is with us! Who can stand before such strength, before the Empire? No one!

@28.en: We shall remain strong, comrades! For the Motherland!

My back! The pain... Something is wrong with my spine...

Twelve heroes storm the domain

Of Nihaz who only craves destruction.

Hedus blocks their path.

The red banner is raised, a battle begins,

And this time Fate is not favorable.

One warrior calls on higher powers,

An elven maiden appears before him.

The heroes did not win victory.

A grave robber named Lara

Suddenly comes to mind.

The girl read on some tablets

That the world is facing imminent doom.

Frightened, she decided to look for ways

To avert the end of the world.

She asked heroes to complete tasks,

But it was all a joke of the Junes.

A tavern owner in Novograd lost her husband

And started looking for another.

She is good at everything - how come she has no luck?

She gets rejected time and again.

The woman is just too amorous,

Often beyond measure.

In the end, she found a gray-haired veteran

Who now keeps a firm rein on his wife.

On the land that is called holy, there was a bloody slaughter.

Seeking a way to win victory,

The Empire and the League turned to the Traders.

Cunning Goblins offered them Holy Weapons.

Khador from Gipat, also known as Bully,

Was tired of being a ghost - the poor man was bored.

He demanded this:

A body must be found for him urgently.

The Wormfaces found a solution:

The Spark would possess the body of a vampire cultist.

Khador was happy until he looked

Into his pants and marveled at what he saw.

On Isa, in the cold lands where the Urun roam

Gerda joins the Winter Watch.

Spotting the Urun, she hides in a snowdrift

It's a miracle she is rescued in time.
Who wants to enjoy true art? We'll be giving a poetry lesson soon!
Only today! Learn history from Aoidos poems!

The time of brave heroes has come.

Dragons cannot hide from the gaze of the merciless Junes.

In response to the threat, the dragons formed an alliance among themselves

Villages are burned down, cities are turned into ruins.

But here come the children of the June genius.

War machines made of metal and stone - Golems.

A dragon's wrath cannot withstand this force.

Defeated, they retreat, and the Junes are now at peace.

The burden of war is borne by the Aro tribes and Orcs.

For years, the enmity does not subside, and people fall into despair.

But difficult times give rise to great heroes - Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan.

After uniting the people, they defeat the horde and drive them back.

But victory alone was not enough for the heroes.

They went to the lands of the horde to put an end to the threat.

The insidious Sevia helped them along the way.

The leader Skulnar was defeated, and the horde was no more.

Nezeb, a son of the Empire, lusted for glory.

He led his army to the Kanian lands and subjugated many.

The grave threat loomed over the land. Heeding the call,

Tensess came to the rescue, shining in the greatness of his power.

A mysterious Seal of Mystery falls on Umoir.

In attempts to solve the mystery,

Brave heroes disappear one by one.

The last four heroes begin their journey,

Coming from distant corners of the land.

Brian and Rud Glaen join them, swearing eternal loyalty.

And together they defeat the demon - the Seal is finally gone.

Skrakan was liberated and the sun rose over Umoir.

Yazes was shrouded in shadows: the age of tyranny arrived.

The vile Urd had usurped the throne, and the people suffered under oppression.

The crown was broken, the radiance of three stars illuminated the heavens.

But then a sorceress sent by Skrakan appeared.

Brave Iglez, courageous Dina, and Galenel -

Together, they went through forests and deserts,

Looking for fragments. When they found them, they uncovered the secret of

Terrible necromancers, and peace was restored.

In the icy land. He found the girl and fell in love.

The trouble was, she had a fiancé, but he had disappeared.

He followed the man's tracks to Suslanger

But found nothing and went back - and it turned out that he was the fiancé.

The ancient people stubbornly sought immortality -

They were horrified by the death of the Junes.

But they were instructed to fear such daring desires.

And punishment descended on the lands of Hickut.

A terrible disease struck the entire nation,

And there was no cure in the world for this scourge.

Over several moons, millions of unfortunates died.

Only the wind blowed sand across the ruins of Hickut.

Nezeb and Tensess - heroes, great men.

Their friendship, once strong like stone,

Was destroyed by a lust for power.

Crows are circling over Kania - there will be a terrible battle.

Pride, a child of vice, poisoned the souls of the mages.

They decided to become equal to the gods, breaking the covenants.

Great power is hidden in the Seals of Nihaz.

The Twelve must take possession of it and rule the world.

But the gods are harsh towards arrogant mortals

And they send down punishment upon the world.

The ground is broken, and many mages perish

The living became gods - kings of the rubble.

Blessed Ammer, home of the bright Aoidoi.

Suffering from demons, the allod is covered by corruption

Brave Kyros and Ellona try to fight them off.

Creatures of the astral plane must be defeated.

But the creatures knew the power of dark magic

That extinguished sparks. When Ellona died,

She could not be resurrected, and Kyros

Plunged into great sorrow, becoming a faithful servant of the Wanderer.

On dusty Grok, where the Orcs roamed, lived Lorzub.

His clan was called the Merciless, and he was unused to hardships.

He was chosen by the Elven mage Elleken.

Changed by the power of the deities, the Orc acquired magic abilities.

Sensing trouble, he fled from the Elves.

After returning to the tribe, he disappeared with his bride.

But he could not escape. He fell in battle.

However, his bloodline was secretly continued.

Nezeb and Skrakan gathered ships, countless warriors,

Mighty mages, and the astral campaign began.

Demon hordes fell one by one.

But the army died there after destroying the portal for nothing.

The roar of the great battle comes.

Two forces collide, tearing into each other.

The mad god Sarn, who yearns for freedom,

And the Architect, the ruler of order.

It happened by the will of one maiden -

One with flame-colored hair.

Her enemies were the god and the creator,

And now they want to destroy each other.

A troop of heroes pursuit the fallen

Son of Ammer known as Kyros.

They bravely step onto the Secret Paths.

Simargl rules there - he is the ruler of secrets.

The heroes are overwhelmed by mysteries,

But they are strong both in body and mind.

The secrets are solved, the guardian is defeated -

A great feat is accomplished.

Oh, let us remember the accomplishments of the heroes of the past.

How they outwitted the god of battles.

They gained his favor,

Listening to advice from the other world.

That force sent them to arenas

To win or be defeated.

Even though it was no heroic feat,

There was a reward for the worthy.

After kidnapping a maiden, a huge Tungar tribe went into hiding.

There was no way to get into the cave.

A new plan was devised

By the cunning hunter Murk who wanted to save Elena.

After collecting fire-spitting lizards,

They saddled a yak, steering it towards the Tungars.

With fire roaring around them, they rode in bravely, sending everyone fleeing.

They saved Elena and found the way up.

The queen's desire was

To help those dear to her.

An artifact, the legacy of the Elves, was given away.

In the icy desert, the trace of the Blood Bond was lost.

An investigation pointed towards the killer.

A lie was distinguished from the truth, and evidence was obtained.

After catching the snake in the snow, the heroes recovered the stolen goods.

They returned those to the queen before the ball, and her honor was preserved.

Discovering only nightmares there,

The heroes went with a different plan, turning to a sage.

He was a gray-haired jinn named Khottab.

He set the heroes on the girl's trail.
